jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Audio, Twitch & Games (ATG) Security
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you excited about building tools and services that help keep millions of customers safe while they enjoy their favorite music, audiobooks, and games? The ATG Security team is growing its software development function, and we're looking for a Software Development Engineer to help design and build the security tools, automations, and services that protect Amazon's media businesses. In this role, you'll work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding the problem, through design and implementation, to testing, deployment, and operations. You'll tackle problems where the business need is clear but the right technical solution still needs to be shaped, and you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how security scales across some of Amazon's most exciting entertainment products.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and maintain security tools, automations, and services that support ATG's media businesses, delivering working software across the full development lifecycle including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Collaborate with security engineers and partner engineering teams across Music, Audible, and Games to understand requirements and deliver solutions that address real security challenges.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing systems and processes, balancing short\-term needs with long\-term architectural goals while keeping solutions simple and maintainable.
* Write clear documentation for the software you build — covering what it does, how it's constructed, and how it fits into the broader security landscape — and actively coach teammates through code reviews.
* Evaluate and integrate generative AI capabilities where appropriate to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of security tooling.

  

A day in the life  

You might start your morning reviewing a pull request from a teammate, then shift into a design session where you and the security engineers map out the architecture for a new automation that reduces manual effort across the team. After lunch, you could spend focused time writing code for a service that integrates with partner systems in Music or Games. You'll regularly connect with stakeholders to understand their pain points and make sure what you're building solves the right problems. Expect a mix of heads\-down coding, collaborative problem\-solving, and operational support.  

  

About the team  

The ATG Security team is responsible for security across Amazon's media organizations, supporting businesses that include Music, Audible, and Games. Within this team, a small but growing development group builds the tools, automations, and security services that help these businesses operate safely at scale. This is a chance to join early and help shape the technical direction of that function.  

  

We value an inclusive team culture where everyone's perspective matters. You'll partner closely with security professionals and engineering teams across ATG, working on problems that span some of Amazon's most recognized entertainment products. If you're looking for a role where your code has visible impact and you can grow alongside the team, we'd love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

jobs.title: C++ Architect
jobs.description:
**Location:**

Krakow, Lesser Poland, Poland
**Job ID:**

R0145080
**Date Posted:**

2026\-09\-28
**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY SERVICES SP. Z O.O.
**Profession (Job Category):**

Engineering \& Science
**Job Schedule:**

Full time
**Remote:**

No
**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced R\&D Software Architect focused on C\+\+ application development for performance‑critical systems to join our technology organization.  



In this role, you will lead the architecture of scalable, high\-performance, and secure software systems built with modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\), with a strong focus on real\-time behavior, reliability, and long product lifecycle support.  



As an R\&D Architect within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.


You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting\-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real\-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long\-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.  



We value diverse experience and fresh perspectives. Even if you do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to learn more about you and the unique strengths you can bring to our team.  



  

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Lead system design in areas like multithreading, synchronization, I/O, and latency requirements for real\-time operation.
* Architect interop layers connecting high\-performance C\+\+ cores to managed runtime services (.NET, RUST) with minimal latency overhead.
* Drive performance optimization and scalability: profile threading behavior, minimizing lock contention, reduce memory allocations in critical paths, and ensure predictable latency at scale.
* Propagate modern programming practices and techniques based on the latest C\+\+ standard.
* Maintain high code quality through code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to SOLID, KISS, DRY and industry best practices.
* Mentor development teams on system design, best practices and maintaining code quality in performance\-critical sections.
* Lead technical architecture reviews, design documentation, and roadmaps for feature development, refactoring initiatives, and legacy code modernization.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transform requirements into clear architectural designs.
* Support strategic technology decisions on dependencies, build tooling, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices.
* Maintain cross\-platform support: drive modernization of build systems, ensure consistency across multiple deployment environments, and support Linux/Windows compatibility.
* Drive Linux development and deployment strategies: architect solutions for Linux environments.
* Contribute to achieving business goals by designing, developing, and delivering high\-quality software solutions.
* Continuously enhance existing systems and contribute to the creation of new features.
* Work effectively within an agile environment, continually expanding your technical expertise and understanding of the business domain.
Actively participate in a cross\-disciplinary team and contribute to shared objectives.  
* 

**Your Background:**

* University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of experience in senior technical or architecture roles.
* Advanced proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\) with deep understanding of RAII, smart pointers, STL, concurrency, and memory management.
* Proven experience with multithreading, synchronization primitives, asynchronous I/O and real\-time system design.
* Proficiency with building systems (CMake, Visual Studio) and cross\-platform development for Windows and Linux.
* Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture patterns; demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low\-latency system; good understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
* Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
* Experience with Cloud, DevOps, deep cybersecurity expertise, UI/web development.
* Knowledge of non\-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
* Practical experience developing systems for power grid management and monitoring having familiarity with WAMS/WAMPAC, PMU data, and protection and control applications; understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards; experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU).
* Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC 61850, IEC\-60870\-5\-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37\.118\).
* Practical experience working directly with power grid industry clients and exposure to system integration, simulators, or lab environments
* Proven ability to translate customer requirements into clear technical designs.
* Solid understanding of numerical methods, signal processing, and control fundamentals and ability to work with high‑frequency, time‑aligned time‑series data
* Good understanding of power system dynamics and the stability challenges introduced by high penetration of renewables
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges; effective team player with good communication skills and willingness to learn.
Excellent command of English (written and spoken).  
* 

  

**More about us**
-----------------

  

We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.


We can provide more information during the recruitment process.  



  

Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:


* Private medical care and life insurance
* Access to fitness and wellness programs
* Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
* Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
* Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
* Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
* Company events and team‑building activities
* Psychological support program
Free parking available  
* 

  

You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.


**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java) – Cloud Communications (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
#### **In this role you will:**

**Design \& build**  

 • Design and implement backend services and APIs in modern Java (21\+), Spring Boot and related frameworks  

 • Build distributed, cloud\-native applications using microservice architectures  

 • Work with container technologies (Docker) and Kubernetes, and collaborate with Platform Engineering on infrastructure\-related changes  

 • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation  

  

**Ship \& operate**  

 • Own services end to end following a “you build it, you run it” mindset — including monitoring, logging, troubleshooting and incident response  

 • Use observability tooling (metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, APM) to keep services healthy in production  

 • Apply secure software development practices, including OWASP Top 10, dependency and secrets management  

  

**Collaborate \& improve**  

 • Work in Agile product teams (Scrum/Kanban) with a collaborative, ownership\-driven mindset  

 • Review code, mentor colleagues, and help raise engineering quality across the team  

 • Use AI\-assisted engineering tools where useful to speed up delivery without compromising quality or security  

  

**Important to know**  

 • You will own services end to end. From design through to running them in production  

 • Cloud\-native and DevOps skills (Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability) matter as much as core Java expertise  

 • You will work closely with Platform Engineering, Security and Product — this is a collaborative, not a siloed, role  

 • Our domain is telecommunications and cloud communications, so telecom background is a strong plus but not a requirement  

 • We use AI\-assisted engineering tools as part of our normal workflow and expect openness to them

#### **We’re looking for a person who has:**


 • 5\+ years of professional experience in software engineering with a strong focus on Java\-based backend systems  

 • Strong knowledge of modern Java (21\+), Spring Boot, Spring Framework, JPA/Hibernate and RESTful API design  

 • Experience designing and implementing distributed, cloud\-native applications using microservices  

 • Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one modern CI/CD tool (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo CD)  

 • Fast learning curve with a track record of adapting to changing tech stacks  

 •
   

• Solid grounding in software quality practices: automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD  

 • Good understanding of secure development practices (OWASP Top 10, dependency \& secrets management)  

 • Experience with observability tooling: metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, APM  

 • Comfortable operating production services and responding to incidents  

 • Strong analytical thinking and sound technical decision\-making in complex distributed systems  

 • Fluent in English (written and spoken); German is a plus

#### **Some nice\-to\-have skills:**


Practical experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) or genuine openness to adopting them  

 • Experience with CPaaS or cloud communications platforms, telecom protocols (SIP, RTP, WebRTC), or related open\-source frameworks (FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, Asterisk)  

 • Familiarity with carrier\-grade, highly available, low\-latency distributed systems  

 • Experience with asynchronous messaging / event\-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

#### **Why Apifonica?**

**What we offer**  

 • Compensation: 21,000–25,000 PLN net \+ VAT/month (B2B), depending on experience  

 • Hybrid working model based in the very center of Warsaw  

 • Private health insurance package and sports card coverage (details will be provided during the recruitment process)  

 • An international B2B technology environment: working with clients from various European markets within a rapidly growing technology company  

 • Focus on artificial intelligence and technology: day\-to\-day work with cutting\-edge AI solutions and digital tools  

 • An influential team: an international, highly productive team with a fast decision\-making process and a tangible impact on the company’s growth  

  

**Apifonica** is a communications automation platform that has been operating in the market for over ten years. AI agents, messaging, voice services and numbers operate on our own telecoms infrastructure, managed by **Tenios** – a company within our group and a licensed German operator that has been operating in the telecoms sector since 2001\. A single contract and a single SLA cover all channels, and a single team is responsible for both the AI logic and call quality.  

  

Every month, we handle over 250 million calls and 70 million messages for more than 1,800 business clients, including MAN, ERGO, Toyota, Generali and Leroy Merlin. Our teams are based in Germany, Poland and Latvia; our head office is in Tallinn; and our infrastructure remains in Europe – it is located in Frankfurt, is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and complies with GDPR requirements.

#### **About us**

**Apifonica** is an Estonian company with its headquarters in Tallinn and offices in Poland, Germany (Tenios brand), Italy, Latvia.  

  

We develop cloud\-based voice and messaging communication solutions that help businesses automate communication with their customers. From simple automated notifications to AI\-powered voice bots that integrate with company IT systems and support sales, customer service and HR processes.  

  

Our added value lies in turning complex communication into simple, efficient and business\-driven solutions, tailored to each client’s needs and goals.


More about Apifonica: www.apifonica.com  

More about Tenios: https://www.tenios.de/

jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to work in a scaled agile environment within international teams developing high\-tech solutions for the medical hearing health care sector. You will be responsible for the development of tools for building, testing, and releasing firmware for our products.

  

More about the role


In this role, you will be part of our R\&D team, and you will be responsible for building an application used by audiologists to adjust the software installed on our new line of hearing aids.


Tasks \& Responsibilities


* Design, develop, test, and maintain software components and features for Sonova's .NET desktop applications and fitting software platform.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers and verification engineers to refine requirements and transform them into effective software solutions.
* Develop intuitive user interfaces using C\#, .NET, WPF, and XAML, including prototyping new concepts and workflows.
* Ensure high software quality through clean code practices, code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to architectural guidelines.
* Perform root cause analysis, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to maintaining a reliable and sustainable software platform.
* Share knowledge, support onboarding activities, and contribute to engineering best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

  

More about you


**Essential qualifications:**


* University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 5\+ years of professional software development in C\# with experience .NET, XAML\-based, MVVM capable UI frameworks like Avalonia, Maui, WPF
* Solid understanding of object\-oriented analysis and design, software architecture, design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean code practices.
* Track record of owning features from idea through release and maintenance.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a passion for delivering high\-quality software.
* Fluent English and confidence communicating in international, distributed teams.

**Good to have qualifications:**


* Experience in regulated environments, ideally medical devices software.
* An interest in audiology or healthcare technology.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, ideally in Azure DevOps.

We understand that you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe this role aligns with your skills and aspirations, we encourage you to apply \- even if you don’t fulfill 100% of the qualifications

  

What we offer


As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

  

Why Join Sonova?


At Sonova, we offer more than just a job — we offer a chance to make an impact. You’ll join a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas matter and your leadership shapes how we serve our customers. With our modern office spaces, focus on employee development, and strong company values, you’ll be empowered to grow both personally and professionally.


Make an impact that resonates. Join Sonova and help us bring the world closer through better hearing.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
jobs.description:
W Scalo zajmujemy się dostarczaniem projektów software'owych i wspieraniem naszych partnerów w rozwijaniu ich biznesu. Tworzymy oprogramowanie, które umożliwia ludziom dokonywanie zmian, działanie w szybszym tempie oraz osiąganie lepszych rezultatów. Wykorzystujemy szerokie spektrum usług IT, aby wspierać naszych klientów w realizacji ich celów biznesowych.



Obszary naszej działalności obejmują m.in.:


* doradztwo technologiczne,


* tworzenie oprogramowania,


* systemy wbudowane,


* rozwiązania chmurowe,


* zarządzanie danymi,


* dedykowane zespoły projektowe.

  



**Cześć! Poznaj możliwości współpracy ze Scalo!**
-------------------------------------------------


**Zakres współpracy obejmuje:**
-------------------------------


* rozwój nowoczesnej platformy cleantech wspierającej operatorów sieci elektroenergetycznych w zarządzaniu rozproszonymi zasobami energetycznymi,
* projektowanie i implementację nowych funkcjonalności zarówno po stronie frontendowej, jak i backendowej,
* rozwój dashboardów służących do monitorowania i predykcyjnego sterowania zasobami energetycznymi w czasie rzeczywistym,
* tworzenie i rozwój warstwy frontendowej z wykorzystaniem React,
* rozwój backendu oraz logiki biznesowej API w Python i FastAPI,
* projektowanie i rozwój modeli danych w PostgreSQL,
* integrację platformy z zewnętrznymi systemami zarządzania energią (EMS),
* udział w tworzeniu nowych rozwiązań w ramach rozwijającego się produktu,
* współpracę z zespołem produktowym i technicznym przy projektowaniu kolejnych funkcjonalności platformy,
* współpracę w modelu 100% remote,
* stawkę do 160zł/h NET \+ VAT na B2B w zależności od doświadczenia.

**Kompetencje wymagane do realizacji usług:**
---------------------------------------------


* seniorskie doświadczenie w tworzeniu aplikacji webowych w roli Full Stack Developera,
* bardzo dobra znajomość **Python**,
* praktyczne doświadczenie z **FastAPI** lub podobnymi frameworkami backendowymi,
* bardzo dobra znajomość **React**,
* doświadczenie w pracy z **PostgreSQL**,
* doświadczenie w projektowaniu i rozwijaniu REST API,
* umiejętność samodzielnego projektowania oraz implementowania nowych funkcjonalności end\-to\-end,
* doświadczenie w pracy nad produktami rozwijanymi od wczesnego etapu będzie dodatkowym atutem,
* bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego.

**Co oferujemy w ramach współpracy?**
-------------------------------------


* możliwość świadczenia usług w **różnorodnych projektach** z obszaru Software, Embedded, Data i Cloud Services,

jobs.description:
### **Job Description**


At AFRY, we believe that sound has the power to shape how people experience the places where they live, work and meet.


We are now looking for an Acoustician with a strong background in building acoustics and environmental noise to join our growing Acoustics, Sound and Vibration team in Sweden, with around 80 acousticians across the country.


This is an opportunity for an ambitious acoustic engineer who wants to work on challenging projects, collaborate with leading specialists across disciplines and contribute to projects both in Sweden and internationally.


As an Acoustician at AFRY, you will work with a broad range of projects within building acoustics and environmental noise. You will be involved from early\-stage studies and concept development through detailed design and construction.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Building acoustics and acoustic design of residential, office, educational, healthcare and public buildings
* Environmental noise assessments related to road and rail traffic, industry and urban development
* Acoustic calculations, modelling and simulations
* Noise mapping and prediction
* Evaluation of acoustic measurements
* Development of acoustic solutions, strategies and mitigation measures
* Preparation of technical specifications
* Providing expert advice to project teams

You will have the opportunity to work across the full project lifecycle and develop your expertise in the areas where you can create the greatest value.


### **Qualifications**


**Must have:**


* A university degree in acoustics, engineering, physics, building physics or a related field
* 5\+ years of professional experience as an acoustician or acoustic consultant
* Solid experience in building acoustics and/or environmental noise
* Experience of acoustic calculations, modelling and technical analysis
* Experience working in multidisciplinary construction or infrastructure projects
* The ability to communicate complex acoustic issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* A structured and independent way of working
* Strong written and spoken English

Experience in building acoustics within **healthcare projects** is particularly valuable.


Experience with software such as SoundPLAN, CadnaA, CadnaB, SONArchitect, INSUL, Bastian, Odeon, Treble, Rhino/Grasshopper, Sketchup, AutoCAD, Revit, BIM is an advantage. Experience with equivalent tools is also highly relevant.


Knowledge of Swedish acoustic standards and regulations is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.


Knowledge and experience within the following areas are particularly valuable:


* Façade and window sound insulation calculations with respect to road and rail traffic noise
* Airborne sound insulation calculations between rooms
* Impact sound insulation calculations between rooms
* Preparation of drawings and documentation specifying acoustic requirements for walls, glazed partitions and doors
* Sound transmission calculations between rooms, including break\-in and break\-out noise through ventilation ducts
* Noise assessment of air handling units and ventilation fan systems
* Room acoustic simulations and calculations, including reverberation time and Speech Transmission Index (STI).

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.

* Helping to shape a sustainable future

We are looking for a senior backend developer in Hørsholm, Denmark or in Gdynia, Poland, to help develop the application of the MUSE Software \- DHI’s integrated offshore wind bird\- and bat\-monitoring and decision\-support system, serving wind farms across the world.


**About DHI**


DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge technologies and products to the market. DHI is fund\-owned, meaning that profit goes to a purpose and not shareholders.


**Responsibilities and challenges**


You will work on designing and delivering the MUSE application and making a difference for endangered birds across the world.


You will be a part of a friendly and diverse team located both in Hørsholm and across Europe. Everyone is passionate about the product and striving to provide our clients with outstanding technical advice and customer service.


**The main responsibilities and challenges in the job are:**


* Design, develop the software application (full stack, mainly backend but there are minor frontend work)
* Contribute to architecture and technical design of the solution
* Troubleshoot and resolve performance, stability and functional issues
* Collaborate closely with local and international colleagues across disciplines spanning Software, infrastructure, hardware and scientific
* Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing

**Qualifications and personal skills**

We expect the following qualifications:


* Bachelor or master degree within computer science or similar
* Minimum 6–8 years of experience in backend development
* Full\- stack development skills
* Strong expertise in C\# with .NET Core
* Experience with, or strong desire to learn:
	+ Sensor networks
	+ Streaming architecture
	+ Event\-based programming
	+ Microservices
	+ Agile/Scrum work practice
Good communication skills in English (written and spoken)  
* 

Nice to have experience with:


* Network
* Cybersecurity
* SQL Databases
* AI computer vision
* Camera / hardware integration experience

Control systems fundamentals \- PID  
* 

Personal skills


* Self\-motivated and proactive
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Structured and quality\-oriented
* Solution\-minded with a focus on delivering value
* A strong drive and desire to learn new skills and areas

**We offer**


To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that contributes to solving some of the world’s most important challenges within water and environment.


We offer:


* Highly skilled and motivated colleagues
* Opportunity to work in an international and collaborative environment
* Flexible working conditions
* A unique chance to contribute to solutions with real\-world environmental impact

**Office location**


You will be located in our office either in Hørsholm, Denmark or in Gdynia, Poland, with close collaboration with international colleagues.


**How to apply**


Please submit your application including CV via the relevant job posting on DHI’s website.


* Deadline for application: October 20th, 2026
* For further information, please contact: Louise Mærsk, mail: lorm@dhigroup.com, mobile: \+45 61 33 51 33

**Expected start date:** 01/11/2026

Louise Rosenberg Maersk lorm@dhigroup.com

DHI are the first people you should call when you have a tough challenge to solve in a water environment – be it a river, a reservoir, an ocean, a coastline, within a city or a factory.
  

  

Our knowledge of water environments is second\-to\-none. It represents 50 years of dedicated research and real\-life experience from more than 140 countries. * You have knowledge about tracking issue system and wiki (e.g. Jira and Confluence)
* You are eager to learn and challenge status quo and are characterized by a very analytical and solution\-oriented way of thinking
* You have effective written and verbal communication
* Able to work well with peers in a collaborative team environment

Please Note: This role requires minimum 3 days/ week work from office


**Minimum Salary:**


zł87,000 Annual
The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.


Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self\-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non\-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.


In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance\-based awards.  



**We Offer:**

* Technical expertise in .net core/C\#, Python, React/Angular, Azure/AWS, Kubernetes services, Open AI, Vector Database, Snowflake, Postgress, Prompt Engineering, SQL, Agent frame works.

jobs.description:
Nexio Management to około 550 konsultantów, którzy od ponad 20 lat tworzą zaawansowane rozwiązania IT dla firm w Polsce i za granicą. Jesteśmy zespołem ekspertów, którzy realnie angażują się w projekty swoich klientów.
  

  

Specjalizujemy się w budowie, rozwoju i utrzymaniu systemów i aplikacji, oraz doradztwie IT. Wierzymy, że najlepsze rozwiązania powstają wtedy, gdy jest przestrzeń na eksperymentowanie \- dlatego mamy własne R\&D Center na czele z NexioBot naszym mobilnym robotem asystującym, wykorzystującym sztuczną inteligencję do komunikacji.
  

  

Działamy w takich modelach biznesowych jak managed services, fixed prices oraz wspieramy zespoły naszych klientów w modelach scale up the team. Naszymi klientami są firmy z wielu zróżnicowanych branż, szukające wsparcia najwyższej klasy ekspertów.


**Opis stanowiska**
-------------------


Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy **Architekta IT / Software Architecta**, który będzie odpowiedzialny za projektowanie i rozwój architektury systemów oraz wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w procesie transformacji technologicznej.


Szukamy osoby, która dobrze odnajduje się na stykutechnologii i biznesu, potrafi podejmować samodzielne decyzje architektoniczne, ale jednocześnie potrafi przełożyć je na konkretne rozwiązania i jasno wyjaśnić ich uzasadnienie.


**Twój zakres obowiązków**
--------------------------


* Projektowanie architektury nowych oraz istniejących systemów, zarówno monolitycznych, jak i opartych o mikroserwisy.
* Prowadzenie i wspieranie procesów modernizacyjnych, w tym refaktoryzacji i migracji systemów.
* Przeprowadzanie analiz technicznych oraz tworzenie dokumentacji architektonicznej.
* Udział w projektach transformacji technologicznej w roli eksperta technologicznego i partnera dla biznesu.
* Rekomendowanie oraz dobór technologii z uwzględnieniem bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i skalowalności.
* Projektowanie i rozwój rozwiązań opartych o API.
* Wsparcie zespołów developerskich w podejmowaniu decyzji technicznych.
* Dzielenie się wiedzą i mentoring techniczny.
* Identyfikowanie obszarów wymagających usprawnień oraz proponowanie kierunków rozwoju architektury.
* Współpraca z zespołami IT, biznesem oraz innymi interesariuszami.
**Nasze wymagania**
-------------------


* Bardzo dobra znajomość **.NET Framework** oraz **.NET Core / .NET 6\+**.
* Doświadczenie w pracy z **PHP 5\.x\-8\.x** oraz starszymi frameworkami, np. Zend, Symfony 2/3\.
* Praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z monolitami oraz ich modernizacji.
* Dobra znajomość **SQL** oraz relacyjnych baz danych, w szczególności **MS SQL, MySQL lub PostgreSQL**.
* Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i budowie **API \- REST, SOAP**; znajomość GraphQL będzie dodatkowym atutem.
* Znajomość wzorców architektonicznych, w szczególności **DDD** (Domain\-Driven Design).
* Umiejętność analizy technicznej i podejmowania decyzji architektonicznych.
* Umiejętność przekładania decyzji technicznych i ich konsekwencji na język biznesu.
* Proaktywne podejście i gotowość do proponowania usprawnień oraz nowych kierunków rozwoju.
* Bardzo dobre umiejętności komunikacyjne i umiejętność współpracy zarówno z zespołami IT, jak i biznesem.
* Samodzielność w podejmowaniu decyzji technicznych.
**To oferujemy**
----------------


* Stabilność zatrudnienia \- długofalowe projekty, współpraca z wiodącymi firmami, możliwość rozwoju w różnych obszarach branży IT.
* Elastyczne formy współpracy \- umowa B2B, umowa o pracę lub zlecenie.
* Benefity: Medicover (rozszerzony o stomatologię), FitProfit, lekcje języka angielskiego.
* Treningi na siłowni F45 \- zlokalizowanej w naszym biurze. Wspólnie ćwiczymy pod okiem profesjonalnych trenerów.
* Wewnętrzny program poleceń.
* Możliwość finansowania certyfikatów IT.

**How You’ll Make An Impact**


**Architecture \& Design**


* Design end\-to\-end Windows server and client infrastructure (on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud).
* Develop and maintain the roadmap for Active Directory (AD DS), Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Certificate Services (PKI).
* Architect hybrid identity solutions integrating on\-prem AD with Azure AD (Entra ID) and Microsoft 365\.
* Design virtualization strategies (Hyper\-V, VMware) and storage configurations for Windows workloads.
* Plan high\-availability, disaster recovery, and backup solutions for Windows systems.
  

**Implementation \& Standards**


* Establish standards for Windows Server (2019/2022/2025\) and Windows 10/11 deployment (imaging, Autopilot, MDM).
* Design automated provisioning workflows using PowerShell, DSC (Desired State Configuration), or Ansible.
* Lead migration projects (e.g., legacy to modern platforms, on\-prem to Azure IaaS/PaaS).
* Define monitoring, patching, and update strategies (Windows Update for Business, WSUS, Azure Update Manager).
* Perform proof of concepts (POC) and proof of architecture (POA) with various hardware and software vendors to pick\-up the best solution.

**Security \& Compliance**


* Embed security best practices (Zero Trust, least privilege, LAPS, Credential Guard).
* Design RBAC models, tiered administration, and privileged access workstations (PAWs).
* Ensure compliance with industry standards (SOC2, ISO 27001, NIST) through audit\-ready Windows configurations.
* Collaborate with security teams on endpoint detection, logging (Sentinel/SIEM), and vulnerability management.

**Collaboration \& Leadership**


* Partner with network, storage, and security architects to ensure interoperability.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and architecture diagrams.
* Mentor system administrators and lead technical review sessions.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies and provide build vs. buy recommendations.
  

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**


* **8\+ years** in systems engineering/administration focused on Microsoft technologies.
* Deep expertise in **Active Directory design** (multiple domains/forests, sites, replication, schema management).
* Strong knowledge of **Windows Server core components** (Failover Clustering, File Server, Storage Spaces Direct).
* Experience designing **hybrid identities** (Entra ID Connect, federation, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access).
* Proficiency with **PowerShell scripting** for automation and configuration management.
* Hands\-on experience with **virtualization** (Hyper\-V, VMware vSphere) and SAN/NAS storage integration.
* Solid understanding of **networking** (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, firewalls) as it relates to Windows environments.
  

**Bonus Points if You Have**


* Certifications: **MCSE (Core Infrastructure)** , **Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate**, **Azure Solutions Architect Expert**, or **Identity and Access Administrator Associate**.
* Experience with **Azure IaaS** (VMs, Scale Sets, Managed Disks, Azure Files) and **Azure ARC**.
* Familiarity with **Infrastructure as Code** (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
* Knowledge of **Citrix** or **AVD** (Azure Virtual Desktop) architecture.
* Exposure to **Linux** systems (basic administration or interoperability).
* Analytical problem\-solver with systematic thinking.
* Excellent documentation and diagramming abilities (Visio, Lucidchart, Draw.io).
* Strong communication skills – able to explain complex infrastructure to non\-technical leaders.
* Ability to lead crisis troubleshooting efforts and root cause analysis.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment under high stress with consistency and accuracy.
  

**Things To Know**


* This role is based in Łódź, Poland and follows a hybrid work model, **requiring 3 days per week in our Łódź office.**
  

**What You Can Expect**


* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)

jobs.title: Senior Back-end/Python Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend / Python Developer to design, build, and evolve scalable backend services and data\-intensive systems supporting our Supply Chain planning solutions.


This is a hands\-on senior engineering role with a strong focus on Python backend development, APIs, databases, system design, and data processing. You will take technical ownership of backend components and contribute to architectural decisions, platform modernization, and the development of reliable and maintainable production systems.


You will work with modern data and AI\-enabled solutions, including data pipelines and services supporting AI/ML workloads. While experience with AI technologies is valuable, the core of this position is strong software engineering and backend development in Python.


The role is suited to an experienced developer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, building production\-grade software, and contributing to both hands\-on implementation and long\-term technical direction.

**Backend \& Python Development**
---------------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain production\-grade backend services and APIs primarily using Python
* Take technical ownership of backend components throughout their lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement
* Design scalable, maintainable, and well\-structured application architectures
* Develop data\-intensive services for ingestion, processing, transformation, and serving of data
* Work extensively with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server
* Design efficient data\-access patterns
* Apply strong object\-oriented design, software engineering principles, and clean coding practices
* Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability bottlenecks
* Ensure high software quality through automated testing, code reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices
* Work with CI/CD and modern development and deployment practices
* Contribute to .NET\-based environments and integrations where relevant
* While the primary focus is backend development, opportunities to contribute to our Vue 3 frontend also exist

**Data Engineering \& AI\-Enabled Systems**
-------------------------------------------

* Develop backend services and data pipelines supporting AI/ML training, evaluation, and inference workloads
* Support the integration and productionization of AI/ML models, engines and services
* Work with technologies and patterns such as RAG, vector databases, and MCP
* Collaborate with application owners to translate application and data requirements into reliable technical solutions
* Contribute to the design of AI\-ready data architectures while maintaining strong software engineering standards

**Architecture \& System Design**
---------------------------------

* Play an active role in backend architecture and technical design decisions
* Design systems for scalability, maintainability, reliability, security, and operational efficiency
* Define and promote engineering patterns, standards, and best practices for Python and backend development
* Evaluate frameworks, libraries, platforms, and technologies based on technical and business requirements
* Make pragmatic architectural decisions that balance delivery needs with long\-term maintainability
* Document architectural decisions, interfaces, and important technical designs

**System Evolution \& Modernization**
-------------------------------------

* Modernize existing and legacy backend implementations
* Refactor complex or brittle components into maintainable, well\-tested solutions
* Improve the reliability, observability, performance, and scalability of existing systems
* Support migrations toward modern service and data architectures
* Identify and address technical debt in a structured and pragmatic way
* Help teams balance short\-term delivery requirements with long\-term technical sustainability

**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**
-----------------------------------------

* Mentor and technically support mid\-level and junior developers
* Perform and contribute to code and architecture reviews
* Support technical planning, estimation, and solution design
* Work closely with product, consultancy, data, AI, and infrastructure teams
* Provide technical expertise in client\-facing consultancy and pre\-sales activities
* Communicate technical concepts, architectural decisions, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* At least 5 years of professional software development experience with Python, with a substantial focus on backend development
* Master of Science (M.Sc.) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering, or another relevant technical field
* Strong knowledge of Python and modern Python software development practices
* Demonstrated experience designing and developing production\-grade backend services and APIs
* Strong understanding of software architecture, object\-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean\-code principles
* Strong experience with SQL and relational databases, preferably including PostgreSQL Microsoft and/or SQL Server
* Experience designing and implementing data\-intensive applications, data processing solutions, or data pipelines
* Experience with automated testing, version control, code reviews, and CI/CD practices
* Experience troubleshooting and optimizing production systems for performance, reliability, and scalability
* Experience working with modern deployment environments, preferably including containers and cloud\-based infrastructure
* Ability to independently drive technical tasks from requirements and design through implementation and production
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams
* Professional working proficiency in English

**Meriting Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Experience with Flask, Pandas or other comparable Python backend frameworks
* Experience with asynchronous Python and distributed or event\-driven systems
* Experience with workflow orchestration and data engineering platforms
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms
* Experience with Azure and the Microsoft technology ecosystem
* Experience with .NET/C\#
* Experience with AI/ML production systems and model integration
* Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM\-based applications, and MCP
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and production operations
* Experience with Vue 3 or other modern frontend technologies
* Experience in Supply Chain, planning, optimization, or related data\-intensive business domains
* Previous experience mentoring developers or acting as a technical lead

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================


You are an experienced Python developer with a strong software engineering foundation and a track record of building reliable backend systems. You are comfortable working across application logic, APIs, databases, data processing, and system architecture, and you understand what it takes to operate software successfully in production.


You enjoy hands\-on development but can also step back and consider the broader architecture. You can make pragmatic technical decisions, explain trade\-offs, improve existing systems, and help other developers grow.


Experience with data engineering and AI\-enabled applications is highly valuable, but deep Python and backend engineering expertise is the foundation of this role.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer**

**Reports to: Engineering Manager**

**Department: Engineering**

**Location: Gothenburg, Remote in Sweden**


Avinode is looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering team on a permanent basis. Over the past year we’ve been on a modernisation streak, reducing our maintenance load to be able to grow the team’s responsibilities and the kind of projects we can sustainably undertake. We’ve recently fully rebuilt our PCI enviornment, and are now undertaking a project to finalise our transition to exclusively running containerised services.


The team you’ll join consists of 4 DevOps/Site Reliability/Platform Engineers, supported by an Engineering Manager with a background in Site Reliability Engineering. We operate a cloud\-only environment and are responsible for its operation, availability, observability and security. Most of our systems are Linux\-based and run Java applications. But for this position we’re looking for someone with experience supporting a .NET/C\# and Windows application stack, or being an experienced .NET/C\# developer with an affinity for platform engineering and cloud infrastructure.

**What you’ll do**

* You’ll support the team as we work through adopting, modernising and rebuilding this part of our cloud environment. This will involve:
* Ensuring the Windows environment remains in good shape, through practices like automated security patching, configuration management and good integration with our observability stack.
* Improving and simplifing our Continuous Integration systems and pipelines.
* Contributing to the applications to improve how they leverage current Azure services, or adopt new Azure services, to reduce the maintenance cost.
* Harmonising how we operate and maintain our Windows and Linux environments, adopting the same toolset and practices across both where feasible.
* Supporting the work to run these applications on a Linux\-backed containerised stack.
* Contributing to the team’s roadmap, which will involve work related to security, observability and improving the developer experience.

**Who you are**

* You are a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer with 3\+ years of experience supporting a .NET/C\# and Windows stack for SaaS services. Or,
* You are a .NET/C\# developer with 3\+ years of experience, with an affinity for cloud infrastructure and at least a year of experience running and operating Windows systems to host SaaS services.
* You have worked with infrastructure in cloud environments before. We use Azure, but experience with AWS or GCP is welcome too.
* You’re familiar with tools like terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure Machine Configuration (or equivalent) etc.
* You have some familiarity with Linux systems and running containers.
* You have an interest in the security of our systems and infrastructure.
* You have a product mindset, seeing the infrastructure and our tooling as services we offer to other teams.
* You are self\-driven and can figure things out on your own with some support from others.

**What do we offer you?**


We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.

* Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations.
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important.
* Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams.

**Want to join our crew?**


Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.title: Systemarkitekt inom C#/.NET
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och digitalisera skogsindustrin och arbeta med teknik som gör verklig skillnad för miljö och hållbarhet? Nu söker vi en Systemarkitekt till ett växande bolag här i Göteborg som utvecklar avancerade system för att effektivisera skogsbruket. Ansök idag\- vi tillämpar löpande urval!
  
  

**OM TJÄNSTEN:**  

I den här rollen får du en central position i ett sammansvetsat utvecklingsteam där du är med och bygger lösningar från grunden och vidareutvecklar befintliga system.
  
Du kommer att arbeta nära slutkunden, vilket ger dig en djup förståelse för verksamhetens behov och hur systemen används i praktiken. Det innebär också korta beslutsvägar och en nära dialog med användare, vilket gör att du snabbt ser effekten av det du utvecklar.
  
Bolaget fokuserar på att digitalisera och effektivisera skogsindustrin genom datadrivna lösningar. En viktig del av arbetet är system kopplade till GIS (geografiska informationssystem), där data används för att exempelvis analysera miljöförändringar, vattennivåer och andra faktorer som påverkar skogsbruket. Du kommer därför att arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan mjukvaruutveckling, dataanalys och verkliga tillämpningar. Tekniskt innebär rollen främst backendutveckling i C\#/.NET, ofta i molnbaserade miljöer inom Microsoft Azure.
  
  

**ARBETSUPPGIFTER:** Utveckla och förbättra molnbaserade applikationer inom Microsoft Azure
  
Arbeta med backendutveckling i C\#/.NET
  
Bidra till lösningar inom GIS och datadrivna analyser
  
Samarbeta nära både interna utvecklare och kund
  
Vara med och effektivisera processer inom skogsindustrin
  
**VI SÖKER DIG SOM:** Har en kandidat\- eller masterexamen inom mjukvaruutveckling, datateknik eller ett annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant
  
Har några års arbetslivserfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
  
Har arbetslivserfarenhet inom C\#/.NET
  
  

**Det inte nödvändigt, men meriterande om du har:**  

Erfarenhet av eller intresse för GIS\-system
  
Arbetslivserfarenhet från skogsindustrin
  
Har erfarenhet av Python och/eller C/C\+\+
  
  

Vidare lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken och framåt, som inte tvekar att ställa frågor när något är oklart och som trivs i att samarbeta med andra. Du är en lagspelare som aktivt bidrar till en positiv och inkluderande teamkultur. Utöver det sitter vår kund i mycket trivsamma, ljusa lokaler där du har tillgång till gemensamt gym.
  
  

**OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:**  

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer till en början att vara anställd av Friday. Ambitionen från kund och vår sida är att du därefter bli tillsvidareanställd hos kundföretaget.
  
**ÖVRIG INFO:** Omfattning: Heltid
  
**Start:** Enligt överenskommelse
  
**Placering:** Göteborg
  
**Lön:** Marknadsmässig månadslön
  
  

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.
  
  

**OM FRIDAY:**  

På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech\-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.
  
Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.
  
Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.


We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory\- and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. The open position is with our DDC PRS product team. We provide personnel\- and workforce management solutions to health regions and municipalities. It is important that you contribute to improving processes and further contribute to us creating solutions that meet the customers' needs and create value for them. * Carry out packaging, technical verification and delivery of new versions of the software.
* Help move on\-prem infrastructure to cloud both internal as well as customer installations.
* Contribute to maintaining Workforce Planner in a cloud environment
* Improve and automate solutions for software packaging, delivery and deployment of the product.
* Maintain and improve technical documentation for installation of the solution.
* Maintain internal environments.
* Carry out migration of the solutions from old to new servers when customers upgrade infrastructure.

* Develop SQL scripts to meet the customer's needs for customized data extraction.
* Maintain and improve infrastructure for automated testing.
* Testing web service APIs.
* Optimize database queries.

* 3\-year education in ICT.
	+ Relevant experience can compensate for a lack of formal education.
* Experience with:

	+ IIS and configuration of web applications.

* Version management systems such as Git.
* Container frameworks such as Docker.
* Programming skills in C\#.
* Testing web services with Bruno/Postman or similar tools.
* Infrastructure management on Azure.

 **AI knowledge requirement**


AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarizing, analyzing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).

 **What’s in it for you?**

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing products beneficial for health regions and municipalities. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, an open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work\-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.


Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. Som software engineer utvecklar du mjukvara och verktyg som stöttar våra tekniska plattformar och system. Du arbetar nära områden som systemnära utveckling, nätverk, databaser och andra centrala komponenter som är avgörande för våra produkter.


Du blir en del av ett agilt team där du bidrar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från krav och design till implementation och test. Du har en teknisk bakgrund inom exempelvis datavetenskap eller ingenjörsområdet och drivs av att utvecklas som software engineer i komplexa system.

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds readiness and resilience software for defence, public safety and critical infrastructure organisations in more than 70 countries. Our Exonaut platform is used to plan, run and evaluate large\-scale training, exercises and capability evaluations, and our consultants and engineers work alongside those organisations across Europe, North America and beyond.

**What we're building**


We're building the evidence layer for defence experimentation and evaluation. When an organisation tests a new capability — a sensor, an autonomous system, a different way of operating — it has to be able to defend the result afterwards, to someone who was not there and who has every reason to challenge it. Today that evidence lives in spreadsheets, documents and standalone survey tools, and it cannot be traced from a conclusion back to the observation that supports it.


Our platform fixes the structure before the data is collected, captures evidence from people and from machines, fuses it into chains that carry their own provenance, and keeps every finding traceable to its source. The hard part is not the plumbing. It is holding one coherent model steady while every customer arrives with their own vocabulary, their own method and a reasonable\-sounding request for one more special case.

**How we build**


Modern Java — currently 25 — and Spring Boot on a modular JPMS architecture, an Angular 21 single\-page application, PostgreSQL with PostGIS, deployed to Kubernetes.


The principles are conservative on purpose. Dependency inversion at every module boundary: contracts in an API module, implementation separate, no reverse dependencies. Schema evolution is explicit and reversible, through migrations with rollback scripts and no auto\-DDL in any environment. Evolutionary change over rewrites, with a staged path when a domain concern outgrows its boundary. Structural decisions are argued in RFCs and recorded in ADRs, and changes to the core domain model go through that process rather than around it — because that model is the product, and it is the thing most easily damaged under delivery pressure.


Three constraints shape most of what we do. It runs inside the customer's own environment: single\-tenant, sovereign, accredited, sometimes with no route to the internet at all, so nothing may assume a managed cloud service. Evidence has to be captured where the work happens, which means a tablet in a field with no connectivity and a sync that loses nothing. And the audit trail is immutable — evidence cannot be quietly deleted or backdated, and no automated process publishes a conclusion without a person taking responsibility for it.

**You**


We are a small team, so you will work across the stack rather than behind a specialism. Substantial experience in either Java or TypeScript, and a genuine willingness to be useful in the other. Sound judgement about data modelling, because most of the interesting problems here are modelling problems wearing engineering clothes. Comfortable with ambiguity: requirements move, and the shape of the answer is often the work.


A real advantage, though none of it is required: sovereign, air\-gapped or accredited deployments; offline\-first or sync\-heavy applications; geospatial data; sensor, telemetry or simulation integration; audit and traceability requirements. The domain is learnable, the judgement less so.


The team is small enough that your work is visible and your arguments carry. Your designs will be challenged and you will be expected to challenge back — including on scope.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Capability decisions get made on this evidence. When an organisation concludes that something is ready, or that it is not, that judgement has consequences for the people who depend on it. Making it defensible is the whole point.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript,


Python or Go).

* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why join 4C Strategies**


This is a small team with a large surface. You will not be handed a narrow lane: the platform is still being shaped, the domain model is still being argued about, and the person who makes the argument well is the person who decides. If you would rather own a hard, open problem end to end than take tickets from a backlog, that is the job.


The work matters: what you build helps defence, public safety and resilience organisations prepare for the situations they hope not to face.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer**

**Reports to: Engineering Manager**

**Department: Engineering**

**Location: Gothenburg, Remote in Sweden**


Avinode is looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering team on a permanent basis. Over the past year we’ve been on a modernisation streak, reducing our maintenance load to be able to grow the team’s responsibilities and the kind of projects we can sustainably undertake. We’ve recently fully rebuilt our PCI enviornment, and are now undertaking a project to finalise our transition to exclusively running containerised services.


The team you’ll join consists of 4 DevOps/Site Reliability/Platform Engineers, supported by an Engineering Manager with a background in Site Reliability Engineering. We operate a cloud\-only environment and are responsible for its operation, availability, observability and security. Most of our systems are Linux\-based and run Java applications. But for this position we’re looking for someone with experience supporting a .NET/C\# and Windows application stack, or being an experienced .NET/C\# developer with an affinity for platform engineering and cloud infrastructure.

**What you’ll do**


You’ll support the team as we work through adopting, modernising and rebuilding this part of our cloud environment. This will involve:

* Ensuring the Windows environment remains in good shape, through practices like automated security patching, configuration management and good integration with our observability stack.
* Improving and simplifing our Continuous Integration systems and pipelines.
* Contributing to the applications to improve how they leverage current Azure services, or adopt new Azure services, to reduce the maintenance cost.
* Harmonising how we operate and maintain our Windows and Linux environments, adopting the same toolset and practices across both where feasible.
* Supporting the work to run these applications on a Linux\-backed containerised stack.

**Who you are**

jobs.title: Integration Platform Engineer (.NET/API)
jobs.description:
**Om rollen**


Hemsö är ett av Sveriges största fastighetsbolag med ett växande bestånd i Sverige, Finland och Tyskland. Vi befinner oss mitt i en ambitiös digitaliseringsresa — Digitala Klivet 2030 — där smart förvaltning, datadrivna beslut och sömlösa systemkopplingar är avgörande för att nå våra mål


Som Integration Platform Lead äger du den tekniska infrastruktur som binder samman Hemsös system. Du ansvarar för API\-plattformen och de integrationer som möjliggör allt från felanmälan till dataflöden mot vår analysplattform. Det är en roll med tydligt systemägarskap, bred teknisk räckvidd och direktpåverkan på hur Hemsö fungerar i vardagen.


Vad du kommer att göra:

**API\-plattform och integrationer**


Du är systemansvarig för Hemsös integrations\- och API\-plattform och de integrationer som kopplar samman verksamhetens system — fastighetssystem, felanmälan, HR, ekonomi och dataflöden mot analysplattformen ThoughtSpot. Du designar, bygger och förvaltar dessa kopplingar i .NET och Azure, inklusive automatiserade jobb som synkar data och triggar flöden mellan system. Du ansvarar även för den underliggande infrastrukturen, som definieras med Terraform och hanteras genom Azure DevOps\-pipelines. Du håller ett löpande fokus på stabilitet, teknisk skuld och beroenden.

**Felanmälan och Topdesk\-ekosystemet**


Du har förvaltnings\- och utvecklingsansvar för felanmälansflödet samt Hemsös hyresgästportal och de integrationer som omger Topdesk. Det innebär att du säkerställer att kopplingarna mot kringliggande system fungerar korrekt, att processlogiken hålls intakt vid förändringar, och att du kommunicerar proaktivt med berörda parter när något behöver justeras. Du samarbetar nära med den projektledare som äger felanmälansprocessen.

**Driftstabilitet och systemförvaltning**


Du hanterar uppdateringar, säkerhetspatchar och livscykelförändringar i en miljö med många externa beroenden. När en partner ändrar sitt API, en driftmiljö förändras eller ett certifikat löper ut ser du till att det landar utan störningar. Du arbetar proaktivt, dokumenterar tydligt och håller intressenter informerade i god tid. Vid incidenter eller driftstörningar samordnar du felsökning, driver dialogen med berörda parter och säkerställer att åtgärder vidtas för att minska risken för återkommande problem.

**AI som arbetsverktyg och agent\-enabler**


Du använder AI\-stödda verktyg naturligt i ditt dagliga arbete — för att skriva kod snabbare, felsöka smartare och bygga bättre lösningar. Du bidrar också till att Hemsös agentplattform (som ligger på Databricks) får de integrationer och API:er den behöver för att fungera i praktiken. Det är inte din roll att äga agentutvecklingen, men du är en möjlig\-görare för det arbetet. Du kan även vara behjälplig att ta ett egenutvecklat system från Claude Code/Lovable till produktion.

**Vem vi söker**


Du har gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i .NET och känner dig hemma i Azure — App Services, Functions, integrationsflöden och API\-design. Du har arbetat i miljöer med många systemberoenden och vet vad det innebär att äga en plattform på riktigt: inte bara koda, utan förvalta, prioritera och hålla ihop helheten över tid. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med Infrastructure as Code och automatiserade driftsättningar.


Du är självgående och trivs i en roll där ansvar och frihet hänger ihop. Du kommunicerar lika naturligt med en kollega i förvaltningen som undrar varför felanmälan inte fungerar som med en backend\-arkitekt som vill diskutera integrationsmönster. Du är nyfiken på AI\-verktyg och ser dem som ett sätt att leverera bättre — inte som ett buzzword.


Erfarenhet av HTMX eller liknande server\-side rendering\-mönster är ett plus — rollen arbetar med gränssnitt som Mina sidor och felanmälan, där designkomponenter redan är på plats och en backend\-profil förväntas kunna bidra till frontendutvecklingen. Det samma gäller bakgrund från verksamhetsnära systemarbete där tekniken behöver möta processer och människor, inte bara andra system.

**Vi erbjuder**


Hos Hemsö får du möjlighet att påverka investeringar och projekt som gör verklig skillnad för människor och samhällen. Du blir en del av en organisation med långsiktigt perspektiv, hög kompetens och korta beslutsvägar. Här kombineras professionell utveckling med ett tydligt samhällsuppdrag och en kultur som präglas av ansvar, samarbete och tillit.

**Om Hemsö**


Hemsö är ett av Sveriges ledande fastighetsbolag inom samhällsfastigheter. Vi äger, förvaltar och utvecklar miljöer där människor bor, lär, vårdas och arbetar. Vår verksamhet finns i Sverige, Finland och Tyskland. Vår vision är att stärka samhällets ryggrad genom långsiktigt hållbara investeringar som skapar trygghet, nytta och värde – både för våra hyresgäster och för samhället i stort.


Hos oss arbetar engagerade medarbetare som delar en stark värdegrund präglad av ansvarstagande, samarbete och utveckling. Vi kombinerar professionalism med omtanke och erbjuder en arbetsmiljö där du får möjlighet att växa – både i din roll och som individ.

**Ansökan**


I denna rekrytering samarbetar Hemsö med Alpaca Talent. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Diana Nesic Possman på diana@alpacatalent.com Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan. Alla ansökningar och kontakter hanteras konfidentiellt.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Flight Operations - Backend
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer \- Flight Operations Backend**
=========================================================


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a leading role in the development of the Avinode Flight Operations product offering. As a member of a product team made up of a Product Manager, UX Designer, Test Lead, and Software Engineers, you will plan, implement, and release business\-critical features for customers across the business aviation industry.

**What you will do**

* Working together with your teammates, design appropriate technical solutions to implement new product features and improve current features. You will be working both in our existing C\# .NET monolith (with React frontend) as well as developing new services when needed.
* Maintain and improve the team’s CI/CD tooling, including cloud deployments to Azure.
* Work to bring our codebase up to date with current best practices, libraries, and platforms.
* Research and advocate for new technologies and techniques that would be beneficial to your team and/or the wider Engineering organisation.
* Act as a mentor to less experienced engineers as a technical resource to Avinode Group as a whole, providing information, advice, and technical assistance when requested.

**Who you are**

* You have 7\+ years of experience building systems with .Net Framework and .Net Core and some experience working with React frontends. You are more experienced with backend development, but you will be expected to contribute to all parts of the stack when necessary.
* You have 2\+ years experience with relational databases and related tooling such as ORMs. We use MS SQL Server, but experience with another major RDBMS such as Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, etc is fine.
* You have experience managing and securing resources in a major public cloud such as Azure (which we use), AWS, or GCP.
* You have a proven track record of leading projects, mentoring other members of your team, and researching and integrating new tools and technologies into your work.
* You are familiar with software development and delivery best practices, and know how to ensure your team is following them.
* You communicate well. With offices in multiple time zones and multiple countries, this position requires strong written and verbal communication skills.

**What do we offer you?**


We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.

* Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations.
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important.
* Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams.

**Want to join our crew?**


Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!
