jobs.title: Professional Electrical Engineer, Projects & Overhauls
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29209
Category: Engineering \- Electrical
Job Type: Full\-time  

The Generation Engineering department in ESB Engineering and Major Projects (EMP) is the centre of engineering for ESB’s generation businesses. The Projects \& Overhauls department function within Generation Engineering is to aide ESB Generation \& Trading (G\&T) in the delivery of overhauls \& outages across the asset portfolio, both thermal \& Hydro focused.


We currently have an opportunity for Senior Electrical Engineers within the Projects \& Overhauls Team in Generation Engineering. The successful candidate will support ESB with the management of overhaul projects on existing assets for ESB G\&T.


Suitable candidates will aide in the technical delivery of electrical plant overhauls across the ESB Generation portfolio, both thermal \& Hydro focused. Aligned with same, candidates should have a background in construction, commissioning, maintenance, or operation of:

  

* Generators


* AVR Systems


* MV/LV Switchgear \& Technologies


* Electrical Control \- Systems \& Protections


* Transformers


* Power Generation Electrical Balance of Plant Technologies.


* Knowledge of Power Generation Control Systems (DCS).


* Other heavy industrial experience as applicable.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to the following:


* Support Overhaul Planning \& Programme: Aide the Station \& Project Manager in the planning phase through to safe \& efficient delivery of electrical plant scopes aligned with Overhaul / Outage programmes.


* Support the Asset Management Process: Support on technical input, liaison with Asset Specialists \& reporting on assets pre/post overhaul to the aide in the Long\-Term Asset Planning.


* Advance experience \& knowledge in Generation assets: In preparation \& delivery of overhauls, develop a thorough understanding of electrical asset types applicable to each station, including electrical balance of plant areas. (Plant area knowledge training for specific asset types will be provided).


* Contract Management \& Procurement: Manage allocated electrical contracts and other assigned work scopes, including procurement elements such as specification generation, tendering, evaluations \& awards.


* Safety Compliance: Ensure all project works comply with statutory safety, health, and environmental regulations and ESB Technical Standards \& Guidelines. Where required, carry out authorized roles under the safety rules (Safe Systems of Work), training for same \& plant area knowledge development will be provided.


* Inspection \& Test Plans: Implement Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs) for electrical assets in collaboration with the relevant internal Competent Persons and/or Asset Management Specialists.


* Supervision \& Quality Assurance: Supervise contractors' work daily, review ITP protocol sheets, and ensure work quality aligns with Project Quality Plan. Quality assurance at the work interface will be a key feature of the role.


* Audits \& Reporting: Conduct regular safety, environment, and quality audits; report progress against schedule; attend project meetings.


* Outage Planning \& Execution: Plan and supervise engineering site works for outages and overhauls on main/ ancillary electrical plant equipment.

  

**Experience and Qualifications**


* Proven track record of significant experience in the power generation industry. A minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience is required.


* The candidate will possess competence in design, construction, commissioning, maintenance or operation of electrical systems in power generation or related process/ heavy industry.


* Strong interpersonal skills, ability to manage stakeholders, to work and share knowledge within a team structure and to make quality decisions and judgements


* The candidate will possess project engineering and project management skills, strong time management and prioritisation skills


* Strong communication, report writing skills and proficient computer skills (including MS Office)


* Well versed with health, safety, construction and environment standards and procedures, including risk assessment skills


* Full clean driving license (B car licence)

  

**Essential**


* Primary Degree in Electrical Engineering (Level 8 NFQ) or equivalent relevant work experience.

  

**Desirable**


* Chartered Engineering status with a recognised engineering institution or demonstrable evidence of progress towards same is preferred.

  

**Location**


ESB Engineering and Major Projects office, The Sidings, Grand Canal Dock, Dublin 2 or EMP Eastgate Cork. Due to the nature of the work most time will be spent on site for the preparation and delivery of overhaul works. Flexibility is important in this role as the role may require include travel both nationally \& internationally.

  

**Reporting to**


Projects \& Overhauls Team Leader – Generation Engineering Delivery

  

* **Why Work with Us?**



	+ Opportunity to lead Ireland’s transition to net zero carbon future
	+ Career development through mentoring and training
	+ Corporate Social Responsibility Opportunities
	+ Sports and Social Clubs
	+ Networking opportunities
	+ Credit Union
	+ Generous Pension
	+ Access to staff well\-being programmes
	+ Generous parental leave entitlements
	+ Strong values\-based and inclusive culture
	+ Strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
	+ Great team environment working to our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted**Salary**


€59,000 \- €70,000 per annum

  

**Closing Date**


12th October 2026

  

**Interview**


Candidates shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:



	+ Accountable and Ethical
	+ Collaborative
	+ Growing and Adaptive
	+ Proactive
	+ Respectful and SupportiveMore information is available on Our People Promise

  

**Notes**


Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.


The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland prior to commencement of employment.
**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**


ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.


**About ESB**


Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - IAM
jobs.description:
**What you tell your friends you do**


“I develop the identity and access management that keeps Aize secure and seamless, shaping the product experience as much as the code.”

**What you will really be doing**

Build and evolve responsive React and TypeScript experiences that make complex IAM workflows clear and intuitive.


Make pragmatic design decisions with product managers and our design system team, keeping the application cohesive while balancing functionality and deadlines.


Design and maintain integrations between our portal, backend services, and assorted third\-party systems.


Work across a broad surface area: backend, React frontend, and the DevOps infrastructure that keeps everything running.


Shape features with the product team scoping, estimating, and challenging the “why” behind what we build.


Mentor teammates, contribute to architectural discussions, and help facilitate agile ceremonies.


Support a team that owns everything end\-to\-end, from infra to UI, in a domain where you can grow.

**How you will be doing this**

* Working as part of a self\-driven team of seven that owns an entire “app within the app” \- full flow, full responsibility.
* Using and improving our DevOps setup (Terraform, CI/CD, cloud platforms), building on the foundations already established.
* Mostly focusing on frontend, but with the opportunity to jump into frontend and infrastructure when it makes sense.
* Collaborating closely with other engineering teams and other disciplines to balance technical depth with user and business needs.
* Bring your experience, curiosity, and the right attitude to help the team scale.

**Why you are doing this**


You are building a secure, scalable backbone that enables the product to function reliably as it grows. It protects customer trust and ensures users can access the product seamlessly.

**Who we think you are**

* An engineer who takes ownership, makes sound design and technical decisions, and navigates a broad product landscape.
* Strong in React and TypeScript, with experience building maintainable, accessible, and user\-friendly applications.
* Comfortable contributing to CI/CD and modern development practices; experience owning pipelines or third\-party systems is a plus.
* Curious about IAM or identity\-related domains, even if you haven’t worked in them before; C\#/.NET backend knowledge is a plus.
* Experience with identity solutions or platforms such as Auth0, Frontegg, Keycloak, Identiy Server is a plus.
* Comfortable collaborating with product managers, designers, and engineers, coordinating work, and contributing to architectural discussions.
* Someone who thinks holistically: cohesive product design, purpose, users, functionality, and deadlines \- not just code.

**Team**


We build and maintain the secure, scalable foundations that power the product, including user access and core platform services. Our work is AI\-enabled and follows modern software development lifecycle practices.


We collaborate closely across engineering, product, and security, supported by structured ceremonies, clear roadmap, and shared ownership. We practice continuous delivery using feature toggles to release changes safely and incrementally.

*Grounded*, *human*, and *unstoppable* are the values that guide our day\-to\-day. If that aligns with how you like to work, we’d love to hear from you

**We offer:**

* Money
* Hybrid work and flexible hours
* A MacBook or laptop running Windows, so you can get work done
* Support to help you keep your money: we chip in on your pension, pay for your work travels and keep you safe with insurance
* Care for your wellbeing, including an on\-site private health clinic and covered check\-ups
* Room for you to do things your way and be who you are
* Opportunities to learn and share through our professional Guilds, helping you grow your skills and inspire those around you
* Vacation perks \- maybe a few days at one of our cabins (Gaustablikk, Beitostølen, Hafjell, Tjøme, Spain \+\+). Just remember to come back
* Support for your passions through events, training and courses, you choose what interests you
* And of course the good stuff \- free phone plan, home broadband, solid hardware, on\-site gym, great lunch, afterwork socials and occasional celebration along the way

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Fast stilling Heltid Oslo
* Søknadsfrist **Snarest**
* Arbeidsspråk **Norsk**
* Sektor **Privat**

  
**Senior dataingeniør, eiendoms\- og geodata**
==============================================


Vi søker en erfaren dataingeniør som vil bygge og drifte dataplattformen bak Placepoint. Du henter inn, modellerer og leverer eiendoms\-, selskaps\- og kartdata fra Norge og Sverige, sammen med oss to som gjør det i dag, og du bruker AI som et fast verktøy i jobben.


Om oss
Placepoint samler eiendomsinformasjon, eierskap, regulering, transaksjoner og kartdata i én plattform for Norge og Sverige. Over 850 kunder bruker oss, blant dem eiendomsbesittere, utviklere, banker, forsikringsselskaper, meglere og advokater. Vi er over 70 ansatte og holder til i Oslo sentrum.
  

Dataene er kjernen i det vi leverer. Vi henter dem fra offentlige registre som Matrikkelen, Grunnboken og Enhetsregisteret, fra svenske kilder som Lantmäteriet og Bolagsverket, og fra over 2 300 kartlag. Kundene bruker dem i Placepoint Fusion, Placepoint API og gjennom våre MCP\-servere som lar AI\-assistenter slå opp i dataene direkte.  

  



Slik jobber vi
AI er en del av hvordan vi utvikler. Hvert repo har instruksjoner for Claude Code og Cursor, mye av koden skrives sammen med en AI\-agent, og vi bygger egne MCP\-servere så kunder og kolleger kan bruke dataene våre fra Claude og andre assistenter. Vi forventer at du bruker AI mye, og at du er med på å finne ut hvordan vi kan bruke det bedre.
  

Vi er et lite datateam med bredt ansvar. Den som bygger et dataløp, drifter det også, og vi rydder opp i årsaken når noe feiler.  

  



Dette skal du jobbe med
* Utvikle og optimalisere databasene våre i SQL Server og PostGIS: lagrede prosedyrer, datamodeller, indekser, partisjonering og ytelse på store tabeller.
* Bygge og drifte dataløp som henter registerdata hver natt og hver uke, med Azure Data Factory, Python\-jobber i Azure og dbt.
* Følge med på at kjøringene går, finne feilen når de ikke gjør det, og gjøre dem robuste nok til at det skjer sjeldnere.
* Modellere og koble norske og svenske registre: eiendom, bygg, adresser, selskaper, roller, eierskap og transaksjoner.
* Videreutvikle Placepoint API, MCP\-serverne våre og søkeindeksene i Azure AI Search.
* Ta inn nye kartlag og datakilder, og holde dem oppdatert.
* Levere datasett til kunder og hjelpe kolleger i produkt og salg med data og analyser.

Vi ser etter deg som
* har minst seks års relevant arbeidserfaring
* har høyere utdanning innen informatikk, geomatikk, matematikk eller lignende, eller tilsvarende arbeidserfaring
* er svært god på SQL Server eller PostgreSQL: du skriver effektiv SQL, leser spørringsplaner, lager indekser som holder og modellerer data som skal leve lenge
* har bygget og driftet dataløp i produksjon, med Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt eller tilsvarende
* programmerer godt i Python eller C\#, gjerne begge
* bruker Claude, Cursor eller lignende AI\-verktøy mye i hverdagen, eller er motivert for å gjøre det
* snakker og skriver norsk flytende

Det er et pluss om du har erfaring med
* PostGIS og geodata: geometri, koordinatsystemer som EUREF89 UTM, GeoJSON, GeoParquet og vektorfliser
* norske registre og kartdata: Enhetsregisteret, Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Aksjonærregisteret og FKB fra Kartverket
* svenske registre og data: Lantmäteriet, Bolagsverket og SCB
* API\-design, MCP\-servere og søkemotorer som Azure AI Search eller Elasticsearch
* Azure: Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault og Data Lake
* Go
* 3D\-data og bygningsmodeller
* eiendomsbransjen eller finans

Ingen har alt dette. Vi jobber bredt, og du lærer nye verktøy mens du bruker dem. Det som veier tyngst, er at du lærer fort, bruker AI godt og bryr deg om at dataene er riktige.  

  



Om deg
* Du legger merke til når tall ikke stemmer, og graver til du finner årsaken.
* Du tar ansvar for det du lager, også etter at det er i drift.
* Du jobber selvstendig, deler det du finner og ber om hjelp når det sparer tid.
* Du kan forklare et datasett og begrensningene i det til en kollega som ikke er utvikler.
* Du trives med å jobbe på kontoret sammen med teamet.
**Ferdigheter**
---------------

* Data Engineering
* Data Modeling
* Kodegjennomgang
* kvalitetssikring av data
* Orkestrere musikk
* PostGIS
* Python (dataprogrammering)
* SQL

  
**Om arbeidsgiveren**
---------------------


Placepoint bygger dataplattformen for eiendom i Norge og Sverige.


Banker, eiendomsutviklere, investorer og rådgivere bruker plattformen til å finne, analysere og følge eiendommer, selskaper og planer, med data fra Matrikkelen, Grunnboken, Brønnøysundregistrene, Lantmäteriet og en rekke andre kilder samlet på ett sted.


* Sted: Tordenskiolds Gate 2, 0177 Oslo
* Bransje: Eiendom, IT \- programvare
* Stillingsfunksjon: Dataingeniør
**Nøkkelord**
-------------


lakehouse, dbt, postgis, mcp, ETL



**Spørsmål om stillingen**
--------------------------


FF
Frede Fardal


CPO


JB
Jarle Bjørnbeth


Head of Data

jobs.title: Backend- og DevOps-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce-team
jobs.description:
**Erfaren backend\- og DevOps\-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce\-team**  

Vil du arbejde med både backendudvikling, integrationer og den teknik, der får løsningerne sikkert i drift? Vi søger en erfaren backend\- og DevOps\-udvikler til vores IT Digital Commerce\-team i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Du kommer til at arbejde med de systemer, der ligger bag vores hjemmesider og online booking – fra udvikling og databaser til deployment, fejlsøgning og drift. Vi står foran en større modernisering af vores digitale platform og bookingløsning. Samtidig har vi eksisterende systemer, som skal fungere stabilt, mens vi bygger nyt. Derfor leder vi efter en udvikler, der både kan skrive god kode og interesserer sig for, hvad der sker med løsningen, efter den er deployet.

  

  

**Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?**  

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:


* Udvikle og vedligeholde backend\-løsninger i C\# og .NET
* Bygge og vedligeholde integrationer til hotel\-, booking\- og betalingssystemer
* Arbejde med Microsoft SQL Server og vores databaser
* Automatisere arbejdsgange og driftsopgaver med PowerShell
* Vedligeholde og forbedre vores build\- og deployment\-processer
* Arbejde med overvågning, fejlsøgning og sikker drift
* Være med til at modernisere vores eksisterende løsninger
* Sparre med resten af teamet om arkitektur og tekniske valg


Rollen er en blanding af backendudvikling og DevOps. Du behøver ikke være ekspert i alt, men du skal have solid erfaring og lyst til at arbejde på tværs og tage ansvar for løsningerne hele vejen fra kode til produktion.

  

  

**Vores tekniske setup**  

Vi arbejder blandt andet med:


* C\# og .NET 4\.8 samt .NET 10
* Microsoft SQL Server
* PowerShell
* Windows Server og i mindre omfang Linux
* TeamCity til builds
* Octopus Deploy til deployment
* GitLab
* TypeScript og JavaScript – også i dele af backenden


Vi kommer til at arbejde mere med containerbaseret drift. Derfor er det en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Kubernetes og Docker eller Podman.

  

  

**Hvem er du?**  

Vi forventer, at du har minimum fem års erfaring fra en lignende stilling og en solid baggrund inden for C\# og .NET.


Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:


* Har erfaring med SQL og databaser
* Har arbejdet med eller har interesse for CI/CD, deployment og drift
* Kan sætte dig ind i eksisterende systemer og kode
* Arbejder struktureret med fejlsøgning og problemløsning
* Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs
* Kan forklare tekniske problemstillinger og har lyst til at dele din viden og sparre med resten af teamet


Erfaring med serverdrift, containere eller integrationer mellem flere systemer er en fordel. Vi forventer dog ikke, at du kan sætte flueben ved samtlige teknologier på listen.

  

  

**Dit team**  

Du bliver en del af IT Digital Commerce, hvor vi arbejder med Arp\-Hansen Hotel Groups hjemmesider, bookingløsninger og andre digitale løsninger til vores gæster og hoteller. Teamet består af udviklere, UX’ere og en team lead. Vi arbejder tæt sammen og har en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne. Der er plads til at stille spørgsmål, udfordre eksisterende løsninger og komme med forslag til, hvordan vi kan gøre tingene bedre. Vi udvikler selv vores centrale løsninger. Det betyder, at du kommer tæt på både systemerne og de mennesker, der bruger dem, og at du får mulighed for at være med til at forme den tekniske retning.

  

  

**Din arbejdsplads**  

Vores kontor ligger i Gentofte, og vi arbejder fra kontoret fire dage om ugen. Der er mulighed for én ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag, men stillingen er ikke en remote\-stilling. Du får en hverdag med både nyudvikling, modernisering og ansvar for løsninger, der allerede er i drift. Nogle opgaver er store og langsigtede, mens andre handler om at finde og løse et konkret problem eller få et hotfix i produktion her og nu. Tonen er uformel, og stemningen er uhøjtidelig. Vi siger tingene, som de er, hjælper hinanden og forsøger at holde mængden af unødigt bureaukrati på et minimum.


Vi opfordrer alle – uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion, etnicitet eller baggrund – til at ansøge om arbejde hos os i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Vi tror på, at et mangfoldigt og inkluderende arbejdsmiljø er fundamentet for at opbygge tillid, skabe nærvær og fremme ambitioner. Det er vores mål at placere os helt i front i branchen med fokus på kvalitet, service og trivsel for gæster og medarbejdere. Hos os bliver alle ansøgere vurderet på deres kvalifikationer og potentiale, og vi prioriterer at skabe et miljø, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte.


Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig! Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.


  
Application due
18\-10\-2026  


Start date
Start hurtigst muligt  


Position category
IT\-afdeling  


Position type
Fuldtid  


Workplace  


Homepage
http://www.arp\-hansen.dk  


**Questions regarding the position**
====================================


**Jacob Nielsen**
  
Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group er en familieejet virksomhed med central beliggenhed i København og Aarhus. Vi har over 5000 værelser, 60\+ mødelokaler og en kongressal. Vores hoteller udgør cirka 20 % af Københavns værelseskapacitet og omfatter Phoenix Copenhagen, 71 Nyhavn Hotel, Copenhagen Strand, Imperial Hotel, The Square, Tivoli Hotel \& Congress Center, Copenhagen Island, Gentofte Hotel, 4 Wakeup Copenhagen hoteller samt to luksushostels, Steel House Copenhagen og Next House Copenhagen.



Vores målsætning er at være blandt de bedste i branchen, når det kommer til kvalitet, service og tilfredshed. På vores kontor i Gentofte er vi omkring 100 kolleger, der dækker forskellige støttefunktioner inden for Sales, Marketing \& Brand, HR, Central Group Sales \& Reservations, Sustainability, Supply Chain, Finance og IT. Vores opgave er at give vores kolleger på hotellerne den bedste support, så vi sammen kan fokusere på at give vores gæster de bedste oplevelser.



Siden vores begyndelse i 60'erne har vi været familieejet, og det er familien Arp\-Hansens værdier, der i dag udgør grundlaget for vores virksomhed. Vi behandler vores medarbejdere ordentligt, vi stræber altid efter udvikling og sammen er vi alle en del af familien. Alle vores hoteller og hostels er Green Key certificerede hvilket, sammen med øvrige bæredygtige initiativer, bekræfter vores høje fokus på bæredygtighed.


**Tillid**, **nærvær** og at være **ambitiøs** – vores tre værdier, som afspejler, hvordan vi arbejder i Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group. Vi tror på, at vi vokser, tager mere ansvar og får større arbejdsglæde, når vi bliver vist **tillid** – og får hjælp, når vi har brug for det. **Nærvær** indebærer at være til stede og udvise ægte interesse for både kolleger og gæster på vores hoteller og hostels. At være **ambitiøs** er en naturlig del af at drive forretning. Det er ganske enkelt mere givende, altid at forsøge at gøre tingene lidt bedre.



Hos Arp\-Hansen Hotel Group ser vi dig som den person, du er. Vi er sikre på, at du vil føle dig hjemme hos os, for når du føler dig hjemme, kan du få vores gæster til at føle det samme. "Lad din karriere komme hjem."

jobs.title: Senior CI/CD Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT SIOUX
  
  

Sioux Group was founded in 1996 in the Netherlands. With over 1,400 engineers, Sioux supports or acts as the R\&D partner of leading high\-tech companies. We aim to add value to our clients by developing innovative and high\-tech solutions that contribute to a smarter, safer, healthier, more enjoyable, and more sustainable society.
  
  

Sioux has been recognized as an employer of choice, including awards such as Best ICT Company to Work For and Great Place to Work. In addition to our strong presence in Europe, Sioux is rapidly expanding in Asia, with offices in Vietnam, China, Singapore, and India.
  
  

With a strong heritage and a diverse international team, Sioux is proud of our core values: Own it and make it happen, Grow and innovate together, and Surprise customers. If these values resonate with you, we would love to welcome you to our team.
  
  

We are looking for a Senior CI/CD Engineer based in Asia to make our builds faster, our pipelines more reliable, and our automated testing part of every change. You will focus on build performance for our C\#/.NET and C\+\+ software and on bringing tests and static analysis into CI. You will work closely with development, verification, our test architect and IT\-DevOps teams in Europe and Asia.
  
  

Today, a full end\-to\-end pipeline runs around 200 jobs and over 10,000 automated tests and takes about 4 hours. Your main goal is to cut that time significantly (we aim for around 50% in your first year) while giving developers fast, reliable feedback on every merge request. This is a hands\-on CI/CD role inside engineering, not an infrastructure DevOps role. You will spend most of your time optimising builds and pipelines, and a smaller share keeping them running.
  
  

Key Initiatives
  
  

**Reduce Pipeline Time:**  

Map the critical path, remove waiting between jobs, cut per\-job overhead (clone, artifact download, restore) and cancel redundant pipelines automatically.
  
  

**Job Strategy:**  

**Decide what runs where and when:** fast merge request checks, fuller runs on main and release branches, and complete nightly runs. Group short jobs, split long ones and parallelise long system test suites.
  
  

**Tests in the Pipeline:**  

With the test architect, place each test type in the right pipeline tier, select tests by change where safe, quarantine flaky tests and move coverage runs to scheduled pipelines.
  
  

**Release Pipelines:**  

Make release and cherry\-pick pipelines fast and predictable so fixes reach customers quickly.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Build Performance:**  

Profile and optimise MSBuild\-based builds for C\#/.NET Framework 4\.7 and C\+\+: incremental and parallel builds, NuGet and dependency caching, and removal of bottlenecks.
  
  

**Pipeline Design:**  

Design, standardise and maintain reusable GitLab CI pipeline templates (.gitlab\-ci.yml, DAGs, multi\-project pipelines) across C\#, C\+\+ and Python repositories.
  
  

**Test \& Verification Integration:**  

With the test architect, development and QA/verification leads, embed unit tests, static analysis (Coverity, SonarQube) and automated test bench runs into CI, with clear results reporting. Agree jointly with the test architect which suites run in each pipeline tier.
  
  

**Pipeline Reliability \& Metrics:**  

Investigate failures, remove flaky builds and tests, and track build time, failure rate and pipeline uptime on dashboards to show improvement.
  
  

**Pipeline Operations:**  

Act as first line on the engineering side when pipelines or runners go down: diagnose, restart or re\-run jobs, unblock developers, and hand infrastructure issues to IT\-DevOps with a clear diagnosis.
  
  

**Capacity Input:**  

Give IT\-DevOps data\-backed requirements for build runners and test environments, based on queue times and job durations.
  
  

**Artifact \& Release Automation:**  

Automate versioning, release packaging, artifact staging and package registry management.
  
  

**Developer Workflow:**  

Advise teams on branching and merge strategies, merge request verification gates and fast feedback loops.
  
  

**Scope:**  

GitLab runner management, AWS/cloud infrastructure and GitLab platform administration are owned by the IT\-DevOps team. This role works with them on requirements and issues but does not own that infrastructure. It is their engineering\-side point of contact: first line when pipelines are down, and input on sizing what we need.
  
  

Job requirements
  
  

**Required Qualifications \& Skills:**  

**Experience:**  

5\+ years in CI/CD, build engineering or release automation for multi\-repository C\#/.NET and C\+\+ codebases.
  
  

**Build Systems:**  

Deep hands\-on experience with MSBuild and .NET Framework 4\.x builds on Windows; experience with C\+\+ builds (MSBuild/CMake).
  
  

**CI/CD Platform:**  

**Strong GitLab CI/CD skills:** pipeline authoring, DAGs, multi\-project pipelines, caching and artifact management.
  
  

**Scripting:**  

Strong PowerShell and Python for pipeline logic, build orchestration and log analysis; our build also includes Python\-based simulation.
  
  

**Test Execution in CI:**  

Experience splitting, grouping and parallelising long\-running test suites, and detecting and managing flaky tests.
  
  

**Containers:**  

Working knowledge of Docker for build and test jobs.
  
  

**Problem\-Solving \& Communication:**  

Able to root\-cause complex build, link and test integration failures; clear, fluent English for working across regions.
  
  

Preferred/ Good to Have
  
  

Experience in semiconductor equipment, high\-tech machine automation, or hardware/software integration environments.
  
  

Hands\-on use of Coverity, SonarQube and test management tools (Xray, Jira).
  
  

Experience with build acceleration or distributed build tools.
  
  

Experience migrating old\-style .csproj projects to SDK\-style.
  
  

WHAT WE CAN OFFER
  
  

Our employees are our strength and together we want to achieve the maximum. That is why we invest a lot in our employees, through generous development budgets and personal attention. According to our employees, this is what makes the difference at Sioux. We are proud of that. No matter how experienced you are, you will continue to develop yourself on a personal level and in terms of content. You have a personal training budget of 5,000 SGD available for this, every year.

browser and cloud integrations

In Thermo Fisher Scientific Brno, we develop and produce high\-tech electron microscopes and spectrometers. Our devices are involved in research of SARS\-CoV\-2 virus or enable mobile phones to get smaller. Our work contributes to making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. We are the most prominent production site of electron microscopes worldwide, following a tradition of over 70 years long. There are many experts in physics, electronics, software, mechanical engineering, and logistics among us.


At the Sample Prep and Analysis (SPA) group, we develop and maintain software solutions that automate the operation of Scanning Electron Microscopes (SEMs). Our technology enables customers in the semiconductor industry to identify manufacturing defects, accelerate research, and improve the reliability, performance, and energy efficiency of next\-generation semiconductor devices.

We are looking for a Software Quality Assurance Engineer to help deliver high\-quality software across our product portfolio.


In this role, you will work closely with software engineers, product owners, system architects, and domain experts to ensure our software meets high standards of reliability, performance, and user experience. You will contribute to quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle, design and execute test strategies, develop and maintain automated tests, and help identify opportunities to improve testing processes and product quality.


This is an exciting opportunity to work with software that controls highly sophisticated scientific instruments with nanometer precision in an international R\&D environment. You will apply modern quality engineering practices, leverage test automation and AI\-assisted testing approaches, and contribute to the robustness of software that supports the development and production of the world’s most advanced semiconductor chips and memory technologies.

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer (Europe, 100% remote)
jobs.description:
Join our fully remote, mission\-driven team dedicated to pioneering **sustainable inflight service management**. Work on innovative technology solutions with global impact, collaborate within a diverse, international environment, and continuously enhance your skills through ongoing learning opportunities.


Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland with team members across 11 countries, we offer a dynamic and engaging company culture that celebrates creativity, collaboration, and inclusion.


#### **About the role**


We are hiring a **Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer** to take **end\-to\-end ownership of our data platform and BI layer**.


We are on a mission to contribute to a **zero\-waste future** by drastically reducing food waste, fuel consumption, costs, and most importantly, **CO₂ emissions** in the airline industry. Every role in our company is a direct contributor to this vision \- and as a **Senior Data \& Analytics Engineer** you will be at the forefront of turning data into meaningful insights, empowering our customers to effectively use them and drive real impact.


You will evolve a vendor\-built BI solution into a **modern, product\-grade data platform** and ensure that data is transformed into **scalable, trusted, and actionable insights** for both our customers and internal teams. You’re not just building dashboards, you’re enabling better decisions and measurable impact.


This role combines:

* **Data Engineering** (pipelines, processing, customer facing exports, platform)
* **Analytics Engineering** (modeling, KPIs, semantic layer)
* **Data Product Ownership** (customer impact, insight generation)

#### **What You’ll Own**

**Platform, Architecture \& Pipelines**


Own the end\-to\-end data platform (**Databricks** and **Microsoft Fabric**)

* Design and operate scalable pipelines and lakehouse architecture
* Build scalable ETL/ELT workflows and manage batch/near real\-time processing
* Ensure data quality, reliability, observability, and performance
* Define standards, data contracts, and architecture principles (clean, modular, scalable data platform)
* Optimize cost (e.g. Databricks jobs) and workload distribution across platforms

**Data Modeling \& Semantic Layer**

* Own **Power BI** semantic models and KPIs
* Build clean, scalable dimensional models (star schema)
* Ensure performance and consistency of DAX, aggregations, and dataset refresh

**Customer\-Facing Analytics**

* Build and maintain customer\-facing dashboards and embedded analytics
* Ensure consistent and trusted metrics across all outputs
* Enable self\-service analytics with governance
* Maintain and monitor customer facing exports

**Data as Product**

* Translate business and customer needs into scalable data solutions
* Define KPIs and reporting standards with Product
* Proactively build insights and identify opportunities to create additional customer value
* Drive measurable customer and business impact

**Platform Quality, Operations, Security \& Governance**

* Build necessary validation scripts, unit tests, data quality checks
* Implement CI/CD, testing, and versioning for pipelines and BI
* Support multi\-tenant architecture, security, and governance
* Implement monitoring and alerting (pipelines, refreshes)

**Migration \& Insourcing (Initial Focus)**

* Take ownership of a vendor\-built BI solution
* Reverse\-engineer pipelines, logic, and reports
* Reduce technical debt and rebuild toward a clean architecture

#### **What We’re Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5\+ years in data engineering / analytics engineering for customer\-facing BI products
* Experience in SaaS or product\-driven environments
* Proven track record building scalable data platforms and customer\-facing analytics

**Technical \& Platform Skills**

* Strong experience with:
	+ Databricks (Spark / PySpark, Delta Lake)
	+ Microsoft Fabric or Azure data stack
	+ Power BI (data modeling, DAX, performance)
* Advanced SQL and dimensional modeling (Kimball) expertise
* Lakehouse architecture \& ETL/ELT design
* Multi\-tenant data models \& embedded analytics

**Engineering Practices**

* CI/CD for data pipelines and BI assets
* Write reusable, modular, maintainable and testable code.
* Monitoring and data quality practices
* Version control (e.g., Git)

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Azure infrastructure knowledge (IAM, networking)
* Data quality/testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations)

**Mindset**

* Strong ownership and autonomy: You take full ownership of outcomes, not just tasks
* Impact\-driven: You focus on real\-world results and have strong intuition for identifying patterns, anomalies, and optimization opportunities
* Product thinker: You connect data to user value and turn raw data into clear, actionable insights
* Proactive: You proactively identify opportunities, validate ideas, and build reports, dashboards, and analyses without waiting for requirements.
* Domain expert: You understand business contexts quickly and translate problems into effective data solutions.
* Pragmatic: You prioritize simplicity and avoid overengineering, focusing on what delivers value.
* Clear communicator: You communicate effectively across technical and business stakeholders, making complex topics easy to understand.

#### **Language**


Min. English C1

#### **Expected travel needs**


2 annual one\-week team events

#### **Our Tech Stack**

* C\# (.NET 8–10\), ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core
* Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Blob Storage
* Azure App Services \& Functions, Docker
* Azure Service Bus, Terraform
* GitHub Actions, SonarQube, extensive unit \& integration tests
* Angular Latest Version
* Databricks and Azure Fabric

#### **Hiring Process**

* Recruiter Screen (45 mins)
* Interview with the Hiring Manager (1 hour)
* Technical interview (1 hour)
* Discussion with founder(s) and peer(s) (1 hour)

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work.


Join us and be part of a team committed to shaping a zero\-waste future for aviation, where your ideas and passion truly matter.


Let’s talk!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Founded in Switzerland in 1968, Zühlke is owned by its partners and located across Europe and Asia. We are a global transformation partner, with engineering and innovation in our DNA. We're trusted to help clients envision and build their businesses for the future – to run smarter today while adapting for tomorrow’s markets, customers, and communities. Our multidisciplinary teams specialise in tech strategy and business innovation, digital solutions and applications, and device and systems engineering. We excel in complex, regulated spaces including health and finance, connecting strategy, tech implementation, and operational services to help clients become more effective, resilient businesses.

  

If you share our values and want to do the best work, for the right reasons, we can offer you the chance to do it on a global scale and play a real role in shaping our exciting journey.

**The role**

  

As a Senior Data Engineer, you are a key player in designing, implementing, and maintaining data pipelines and architectures. You work closely with clients to understand their data needs and realise tailored solutions that drive business insights. Your technical expertise and strong methodology help you bring your projects and clients to success.

 **How you’ll make an impact**

  

* Whether in the cloud or an on\-premises data center, you expertly navigate the world of Big Data, helping our clients make their data business\- or operations\-ready.
* You access diverse data sources efficiently and reproducibly.
* You design, test, and monitor distributed data processing pipelines.
* You work closely with data scientists in the creation of machine learning models.
* You perform performance and cost estimations for various use cases.
* You develop and create meaningful dashboards to visualize processed data.

 **What’s important to us**

  

* You are comfortable with Big Data, massively scalable databases, cloud infrastructures, and distributed algorithms.
* You have a passion for sustainable software development and have gathered several years of experience in technical roles.
* Along with your expertise in Python and SQL, you ideally have hands\-on experience or a strong interest in technologies such as Hadoop, Apache Spark, Hive, Airflow, RDBMS, NoSQL, DevOps, Kubernetes, and Java or .NET
* You have a good understanding of the capabilities in large public cloud environments and may have used resources from Amazon AWS, MS Azure, or Google’s GCP.
* You hold a university degree (ETH, Uni, FH) in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a similar field.
* Fluency in both German and English is required for this position.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Remarketing
jobs.description:
**About Us**


At **Nextlane**, we don’t just develop software solutions – we **create the future** of the automotive industry.


We are a company that combines **advanced technology** with a clear vision: **simplifying and digitizing** every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.


We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to **develop** and contribute to meaningful solutions.


So… What does it mean to be a \#Nextlaner?

* Be part of a **growth\-oriented culture**.
* Collaborate with **colleagues from all over the world.**
* Believe in **the Power of ideas** and the **diversity of thought**.
* Be committed to provide an environment where you can **learn, grow, and collaborate** on projects that make a global impact.


Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.


At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to **innovate**, **push boundaries**, and **work on solutions that are transforming** the automotive world.

**Your Responsibilities:**


As Engineering Manager for Remarketing, you will lead an multidisciplinary engineering team of approximately eight people, potentially organized across multiple delivery streams responsible for a complex portfolio of customer\-facing mobile and web applications, backend services, integrations, quality capabilities, and AI\-enabled image\-processing workflows. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will be accountable for team development, engineering execution, delivery predictability, quality, and technical sustainability.


You will partner closely with Product, the Technical Lead, QA, Architecture, DevOps, Customer Success, Professional Services, and other engineering teams. Product owns the vision, roadmap, and the what and why; you own engineering capacity, delivery planning, and feasible execution of the when and how. You will challenge incomplete requirements, ensure work is ready before commitment, and make risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs transparent.


This is a technically credible leadership role rather than a full\-time coding position. You must be able to review designs, challenge architectural decisions, guide engineers and the Technical Lead, and enter the code or production diagnostics when necessary.


This role requires a change\-oriented leader who can improve the operating model while maintaining delivery and production continuity across a complex product landscape.

**What We're Looking For:**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


Team Leadership and Development

* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing multidisciplinary team of approximately eight people, including internal engineers and external contributors.
* Conduct regular one\-to\-one meetings, provide timely feedback, manage performance, and create career\-development plans.
* Own hiring, onboarding, capability planning, career development, continuity planning for critical roles, and recommendations related to progression.
* Strengthen the Technical Lead role and clarify accountability across Engineering, Product, and QA.
* Foster ownership, collaboration, psychological safety, continuous learning, and constructive challenge.
**Delivery Ownership and Predictability**

* Be accountable for engineering execution and delivery predictability across the Remarketing scope.
* Translate roadmap priorities into realistic delivery plans based on capacity, dependencies, risks, technical constraints, and operational workload.
* Provide high\-level estimates and estimated delivery dates, revising them transparently as scope or evidence changes.
* Own sprint planning, execution control, reviews, retrospectives, refinement facilitation, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.
* Protect the team from uncontrolled scope changes and ad hoc requests, ensuring accepted work is visible, prioritized, and traceable in Jira.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies, release readiness, and scope\-versus\-timeline trade\-offs.
* Use engineering and delivery metrics to reduce carry\-over, improve flow, and communicate progress and risk.
**Product and Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Operate under a clear model: Product defines the what and why; Engineering owns feasible execution of the when and how.
* Challenge unclear requirements and ensure initiatives meet agreed Definition of Ready standards before commitment.
* Contribute engineering input to discovery, functional analyses, RFCs, roadmap feasibility, non\-functional requirements, and sequencing.
* Partner with Product to ensure that roadmap items are translated into delivery\-ready epics, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and intended outcomes, before Engineering commits to execution.
* Work with Customer Success, Professional Services, PMO, Sales, and Support through agreed channels and explicit ownership boundaries.
* Participate in customer interactions only exceptionally, primarily for critical technical escalations.
**Quality, SDLC and Operational Excellence**

* Drive a disciplined and traceable SDLC, with Jira as the source of truth for engineering execution.
* Establish and enforce Definitions of Ready and Done, release criteria, quality gates, and consistent issue\-type usage.
* Ensure that the team implements an appropriate automated\-testing strategy across the relevant test levels, in partnership with the Technical Lead and QA.
* Be accountable for integrating security, reliability, observability, performance, and operability into engineering planning and execution, in collaboration with the relevant specialist teams.
* Own engineering participation in incident response, root\-cause analysis, bug triage, corrective actions, and post\-release monitoring.
* Balance roadmap delivery, defects, operational support, technical debt, and modernization.
**Technical Leadership and Modernization**

* Review solution designs, challenge architectural choices, and guide decisions with the Technical Lead and Architecture.
* Provide organizational leadership for modernization initiatives, partnering with the Technical Lead and Architecture on technical direction and execution.
* Ensure that technical decisions across distributed systems, APIs, mobile and web applications, data stores, integrations, and asynchronous workflows are appropriately reviewed and owned.
* Champion SOLID principles, clean and modular architectures, pragmatic domain\-driven design, secure engineering, and useful documentation.
* Ensure technical debt is understood, connected to business impact, and transparently discussed with Product.
* Support the responsible integration of AI\-enabled capabilities and external AI services without requiring specialist model\-development expertise.
**Cloud, DevOps and Production Operations**

* Lead the team in operating cloud workloads, preferably on AWS, with sound decisions on scalability, resilience, security, cost, and service ownership.
* Drive effective CI/CD, infrastructure automation, release management, environment strategy, and rollback practices.
* Use logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service\-level indicators to improve system health.
* Ensure services and integrations meet the availability, resilience, recovery, security, and documentation requirements appropriate to their business criticality.
**SKILLS**

**Leadership and Delivery**

* Strong people management, coaching, hiring, performance management, conflict resolution, and stakeholder communication.
* Proven ability to develop senior engineers and Technical Leads and manage mixed internal and external teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery, capacity planning, dependencies, release planning, and risk management.
* Ability to create clarity and make difficult scope, capacity, and priority trade\-offs.
* Strong command of Agile and lean principles without treating ceremonies as a substitute for outcomes.
* Business\-oriented mindset connecting technical decisions to customer value, quality, cost, and operational impact.
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong software\-engineering foundation and recent experience leading distributed, customer\-facing cloud systems.
* Experience with architecture and modernization across APIs, backend services, web and mobile applications, databases, and integrations.
* Strong experience operating cloud workloads, preferably on AWS, combined with practical knowledge of containers, CI/CD, observability, security, reliability, and production operations.
* Technology\-stack agnostic, with the ability to lead environments that may include .NET, React/Next.js, Flutter, and legacy technologies.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, quality gates, secure SDLC practices, and maintainable software design.
* Ability to lead a team integrating AI\-enabled capabilities and external AI services, without requiring specialist model\-development expertise.
**Language and Soft Skills**

* Fluent English is mandatory; French is a plus.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* High ownership, sound judgement, and effectiveness under ambiguity.
* Constructive assertiveness and confidence to challenge unrealistic commitments or incomplete inputs.
* Collaborative leadership with strong negotiation and cross\-functional skills.
**EXPERIENCE**

* A minimum of 8 years in software engineering, including at least 3 years in engineering management or an equivalent leadership role.
* Proven experience managing and developing multidisciplinary software\-engineering teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering and operating complex SaaS or cloud\-based products in production.
* Experience leading modernization, legacy reduction, or platform evolution while continuing to deliver customer value.
* Experience improving software quality, SDLC discipline, automated testing, release governance, and operational reliability.
* Strong cloud and modern DevOps experience; AWS experience is preferred.
* Experience managing customer\-impacting incidents, cross\-team dependencies, and critical technical escalations.
* Experience in automotive software, digital marketplaces, image processing, mobile products, or AI\-enabled products is advantageous but not required.
**COLLABORATION AND LEADERSHIP**


You will operate as the engineering owner for the Remarketing domain, partnering with Product on roadmap execution while maintaining clear accountability for engineering capacity, delivery, quality, technical sustainability, and team development. Success requires a builder and change\-agent mindset: creating clarity, strengthening ownership, improving the operating model, and helping the team deliver valuable outcomes with greater predictability and confidence.

**Our Recruitment Process:**

* **15\-minute introductory call** with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
* Interview with Engineering Director
* Interview with Product Director.

**What We Offer:**


We understand that **flexibility and trust** are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* **Remote Work:** Up to 3 days a week!
* **Work\-life balance:** We have flexible entrance and departure time.
* **Summer schedule on Fridays:** Start early your weekends!
* **Referral Bonus:** €1500 for every talent you refer (after 6 months).
* **Flexible Remuneration:** COBEE platform.
* **️ Private Medical Insurance:** Adeslas.
* **Continuous Learning:** Access to our internal platform for continuous development.
* **Vacation:** 23 vacation days plus an intensive schedule in July and August.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
At **Naphora Games Group**, we're building more than games, we're building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games.



We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster.



Our goal is to create world\-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high\-performance, ownership\-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you'll fit right in with us.

### **Role Summary**



We're looking for a **Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group** and help us design, build, operate, and scale robust backend systems and platforms.



You'll work hands\-on with backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, and production systems, helping us build reliable and scalable solutions that can support large user bases and growing workloads.



You'll work closely with Engineering, Product, BI, and other teams, contributing to architecture and technical decision\-making while supporting systems throughout their lifecycle, from development through production and live operations.



You'll also work with modern AI services and APIs, integrating AI models and AI\-powered capabilities into our backend systems and products.


### **Responsibilities**


**Backend Development \& Architecture**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems, services, and APIs
* Contribute to system architecture and long\-term technical decisions
* Build service layers and reusable components that can support multiple products and use cases
* Design and optimize database schemas, queries, indexing, and data models
* Build asynchronous systems using queues, workers, scheduled jobs, and event\-driven workflows
* Develop and maintain integrations with external platforms, APIs, and third\-party services


**Scale, Reliability \& Live Operations**


* Design systems capable of supporting high traffic, large user bases, and growing workloads
* Support systems throughout their lifecycle, from development to production and live operations
* Improve backend performance, reliability, security, and maintainability
* Identify technical bottlenecks and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, error handling, and system health tracking
* Investigate and resolve production incidents, performance issues, database bottlenecks, and service degradation


**AI \& Integrations**


* Integrate AI models, tools, and APIs into existing products and backend workflows
* Build reliable interfaces between backend systems and external AI providers
* Design end\-to\-end AI\-enabled workflows connecting AI services with databases, APIs, backend systems, and product logic
* Evaluate opportunities to use AI to improve product capabilities, workflows, and automation


**Collaboration \& Engineering Practices**


* Work closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Infrastructure, and other functions to deliver new features and products
* Participate in technical planning, architecture reviews, and code reviews
* Communicate technical risks, trade\-offs, and solutions clearly
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, system maintainability, and overall technical quality

### **Success Looks Like**


* Building reliable and scalable backend systems that perform effectively as our products and user base grow
* Designing backend services and APIs that are maintainable, reusable, and able to support multiple products
* Maintaining strong system reliability, performance, and uptime in live production environments
* Identifying and resolving production issues, bottlenecks, and scaling challenges effectively
* Building practical AI integrations and workflows that add value to our products and internal systems
* Making thoughtful technical and architectural decisions that support both immediate and long\-term needs
* Contributing to stronger engineering practices, monitoring, reliability, and operational processes
* Collaborating effectively across technical and product teams

### **Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, or equivalent hands\-on experience building complex production systems
* Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining backend systems in production
* Proven experience working on live systems, products, or platforms serving a large number of users
* Experience operating or supporting production environments as part of LiveOps, platform operations, or continuous product operations
* Hands\-on experience integrating AI tools, models, LLMs, or AI APIs into production systems and building practical solutions on top of them
* Ability to design and implement end\-to\-end AI\-enabled workflows connecting AI services with backend systems, databases, APIs, and product logic
* Strong understanding of backend architecture, distributed systems, API design, databases, caching, concurrency, scalability, performance optimization, and system reliability
* Strong experience with at least one backend language or framework such as Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, Java, or C\#
* Strong SQL and database design experience, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar relational databases
* Experience building REST APIs and service\-based architectures
* Experience with Redis or similar caching technologies
* Experience with message queues, workers, or event\-driven systems
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs and external services
* Experience working with cloud\-based production environments
* Hands\-on experience dealing with production challenges such as traffic spikes, service degradation, incidents, database bottlenecks, scaling, and uptime
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
* Able to take ownership of backend systems and technical problems from development through production

jobs.title: FDE - Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**Your role**
-------------

At Kyndryl, **Forward Deployed Engineers work where data, cloud, and AI become real** . This is not a traditional consulting role or a back\-office engineering position. Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customers to design, build, and deploy modern data solutions that operate in complex, regulated, production environments.


As a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) – Data Engineering \& GCP** , you will own defined delivery workstreams within customer engagements, designing and building scalable data platforms, pipelines, and data products primarily on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** .


You will operate with growing independence in customer environments, combining strong hands\-on Data Engineering expertise with business context. You will translate ambiguous business and data challenges into robust, production\-ready solutions, from rapid prototypes and MVPs through industrialization and production deployment.


The role sits at the intersection of **Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, AI enablement, consulting, and delivery accountability** . You will work across the data lifecycle—from ingestion and transformation to orchestration, governance, observability, and data serving—creating trusted data foundations for analytics, operational workloads, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.


You will use modern engineering and AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate solution design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment, while building the customer trust required to drive adoption and long\-term impact.


**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Customer Engagement \& Solution Engineering:** Partner directly with customers to understand business and data challenges and translate them into high\-quality, fit\-for\-purpose technical solutions, balancing delivery speed with scalability, maintainability, security, and long\-term architectural integrity.
* **Data Engineering on GCP:** Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and data platforms using technologies such as **BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer/Airflow, and Dataform** , selecting the right services and patterns for each workload.
* **Data Architecture \& Modernization:** Contribute to the design and implementation of modern cloud data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouse patterns, batch and streaming processing, and migrations from legacy or on\-premises data platforms to GCP.
* **Rapid Prototyping:** Build and iterate PoCs, MVPs, and production\-oriented prototypes to validate architecture decisions, integration patterns, performance, and business value quickly with real customer data and environments.
* **Ownership, Deployment \& Partnership:** Own delivery workstreams end to end—from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production stabilization. Work as part of the customer team rather than operating only as an external advisor.
* **Data Integration \& Processing:** Implement robust batch and real\-time ingestion, transformation, and processing patterns across heterogeneous data sources, APIs, databases, files, event streams, and enterprise platforms.
* **Production Engineering:** Build solutions with production requirements in mind, including **CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, monitoring, observability, security, IAM, data quality, lineage, and operational supportability** .
* **Performance \& Cost Optimization:** Troubleshoot and optimize data workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost, particularly across BigQuery, Spark/Dataproc, Dataflow, and other GCP data services.
* **AI \& ML Data Enablement:** Build and integrate the data foundations required for Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions, including reliable data pipelines, feature preparation, data quality, vector and unstructured data processing, and integration with GCP AI services such as **Vertex AI** .
* **Field Intelligence:** Systematically capture deployment learnings, reusable patterns, technical accelerators, and best practices from customer engagements and share them across Kyndryl engineering and delivery teams.
* **Continuous Learning:** Stay current with the evolving GCP data ecosystem, modern Data Engineering practices, AI\-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies, applying new capabilities pragmatically to customer problems.
* **Platform \& Engineering Contribution:** Contribute reusable code, reference architectures, automation, frameworks, and feedback that improve Kyndryl’s Data \& AI engineering capabilities and accelerate future customer engagements.

  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python, (or another modern language such as C\#, Node.js or TypeScript); experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus •Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git \& GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark •Cloud \& Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures Preferred skills and experience •Open\-Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community\-driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories •T\-shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting •Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi\-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms •Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) \& Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions •Performance \& Security: Knowledge of system\-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems •Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences •Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required •Education: Degree\-level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline \- or equivalent professional experience  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud-Native, AI-Driven Platform)
jobs.description:
**Descripción de la empresa**  

Septeo es un actor europeo líder en el sector del software con presencia internacional, reconocido como uno de los cinco principales proveedores de software vertical en Francia. En plena fase de rápido crecimiento y transformación constante, el grupo se ha consolidado como un referente en la industria del software, impulsado por la fortaleza de unos equipos decididos, audaces y comprometidos.


En Septeo, la inteligencia artificial es el eje de nuestra evolución. La entendemos como un motor de rendimiento sostenible, colaboración e innovación, integrada de manera responsable en las prácticas cotidianas y democratizada en todas nuestras áreas de negocio. Nuestra ambición es clara: «crear software inteligente para Europa».


Nuestra cultura se cimenta en valores sólidos: ser, hacer y transformar juntos. No es una cultura estática; se vive día a día en nuestras acciones y decisiones, logrando un equilibrio entre rendimiento, responsabilidad y disfrute.


Esta ambición se refleja en nuestra labor diaria: diseñar software que acompaña los momentos esenciales de la vida, al servicio de millones de ciudadanos. Desempeñar un papel en estos momentos clave conlleva una gran responsabilidad. Es una responsabilidad que asumimos con orgullo y que pronto podría ser también la tuya.


Unirse a Septeo significa formar parte de un proyecto colectivo internacional, impulsar la transformación del grupo en un entorno de rápida evolución y convertir la IA en un motor tangible de creación de valor, tanto en el presente como en el futuro.

 **Descripción del empleo**  

We are building the next generation of AI\-native software for the hospitality industry. Our platform powers complex, multi\-tenant environments across multiple companies and product lines, operating in high\-availability, high\-performance scenarios.


Our systems handle critical operational workflows where uptime, scalability, and security are non\-negotiable. As we evolve toward AI\-native capabilities and intelligent automation, our infrastructure must be resilient, observable, and ready to scale dynamically.


We believe DevOps is not a support function — it is a core engineering discipline that enables product velocity, reliability, and innovation.


If you enjoy designing robust infrastructure, automating everything, and building platforms that engineers love to use, we’d love to meet you.

**How You’ll Have Impact**

* **Build the Platform Behind the Platform**: Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi\-tenant SaaS ecosystem.
* **Enable Engineering Velocity**: Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.
* **Drive Reliability \& Observability**: Ensure high availability, performance, and real\-time visibility across distributed systems.
* **Architect for Scale**: Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.
* **Champion Infrastructure as Code**: Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.
* **Embed Security by Design**: Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

 **What You’ll Do**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in **AWS and/or Azure**.
* Manage and optimize containerized workloads using **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines (**Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI** or equivalent).
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
* Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.
* Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (**ELK stack**, **Grafana** dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).
* Operate, monitor, and tune **Microsoft SQL Server** databases (performance, backups, high availability).
* Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers (**Java / Kotlin, C\#, Node.js**) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
* Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tooling (**Claude, Codex**, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.


You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

**Cloud Building Blocks: AWS \& Azure**


We run workloads on **both AWS and Azure**. We are looking for solid hands\-on experience with **IaaS** and core managed cloud services on at least one of them — knowing the equivalent on the other cloud is a strong plus. These are the building blocks you’ll work with:

* **Virtual machines \& autoscaling** — Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets \| AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups
* **Virtual networking** — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints \| AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
* **L7 load balancing \+ WAF** — Azure: Application Gateway \+ WAF \| AWS: Application Load Balancer \+ AWS WAF
* **Web app / API hosting** — Azure: App Service \| AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner
* **Managed Kubernetes** — Azure: AKS \| AWS: EKS
* **Message queues** — Azure: Azure Storage — Queues \| AWS: Amazon SQS
* **Object storage** — Azure: Azure Storage — Blobs \| AWS: Amazon S3
* **In\-memory cache** — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis \| AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
* **Managed SQL Server** — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance \| AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
* **Workload identity (secretless auth)** — Azure: Managed Identity \+ DefaultAzureCredential \| AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) \+ SDK default credential chain
* **Secrets \& keys** — Azure: Key Vault \| AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
* **Transactional email** — Azure: Azure Communication Services (Email) \| AWS: Amazon SES
* **Per\-environment configuration** — Azure: App Settings \| AWS: Systems Manager Parameter Store / AppConfig
* **Logs, metrics \& alerts** — Azure: Log Analytics / Azure Monitor \| AWS: Amazon CloudWatch
* **Runtime diagnostics** — Azure: Kudu / App Service diagnostics \| AWS: CloudWatch Logs Insights / SSM Session Manager

  

**Requisitos**  

* 5\+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **AWS or Azure** — experience with both is a strong plus.
* Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with **production experience in Kubernetes** (required).
* Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
* Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft SQL Server** (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
* Experience with **Redis** in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
* Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
* Experience working in high\-availability SaaS environments.
* Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including **Grafana** dashboards and alerting.
* Automation\-first mindset.
* Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
* **Languages**: fluent **Spanish** and professional **English** (both required).


We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands\-on experience with **at least one technology in each area**: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers \& orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases \& caching.

**Nice\-to\-Have Superpowers**

* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
* Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
* Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
* Experience in multi\-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with **both AWS and Azure**.
* Scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* **French** — a huge plus (we can dream!).

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

* High ownership and architectural impact.
* Cloud\-native SaaS platform with real scale challenges.
* Opportunity to shape infrastructure evolution toward AI\-native capabilities.
* Cross\-functional, product\-driven engineering culture.
* International environment with technical autonomy.

  

**Información adicional**  

* Participar en la aventura AI First de Septeo y descubrir nuevas formas de trabajar gracias a la inteligencia artificial.
* Crecer y desarrollarse gracias a un itinerario de formación personalizado y a oportunidades de movilidad interna.
* Vivir una experiencia humana, intercambiar y compartir en eventos temáticos como encuentros afterwork, actividades deportivas, iniciativas de RSC, seminarios y mucho más.
* Unirse a un equipo que cuida de los demás y se compromete con la igualdad de oportunidades, la diversidad y la inclusión.
